AI.title_translation: 一种基于贝叶斯方法的级联失效下相互依赖关键基础设施网络重构研究
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种利用级联失效数据重构关键基础设施网络拓扑的贝叶斯方法，有效解决了因数据隐私导致的网络结构不可见问题。
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施网络的拓扑结构和依赖关系往往因隐私和安全原因不公开，且相互依赖性通常仅在级联失效发生后才能被观测到，因此需要一种能从失效数据中重构网络的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种可扩展的非参数贝叶斯方法，结合Metropolis-Hastings算法及基础设施依赖的提案分布，从级联失效观测数据中重构网络拓扑。
AI.result: 在合成系统上的测试表明，该方法在准确性和计算效率上均优于现有方法；通过对美国谢尔比县及意大利的真实基础设施网络应用，验证了该方法的普适性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效地从级联失效数据中重构相互依赖的基础设施网络拓扑，证明了其在处理现实世界复杂系统中的普适性和优越性。
AI.translation: 分析复杂相互依赖网络的行为需要关于网络拓扑和跨网络依赖链路的完整信息。对于关键基础设施系统等许多应用而言，了解网络相互依赖性对于预测级联失效和规划中断应对至关重要。然而，由于隐私和安全原因，个体网络的拓扑数据往往无法公开。此外，相互依赖的链路通常仅在中断后的级联失效结果中显现。我们提出了一种可扩展的非参数贝叶斯方法，根据级联失效的观测结果重构相互依赖的基础设施网络拓扑。采用Metropolis-Hastings算法结合基础设施依赖的提案分布，以提高采样可能图的效率。对相互依赖基础设施网络合成系统的重构结果表明，该方法在准确性和计算时间上均优于现有方法。我们进一步将此方法应用于重构一个合成系统和两个现实世界相互依赖基础设施网络系统（包括美国田纳西州谢尔比县的天然气-电力-供水网络，以及意大利的电力-供水相互依赖系统），以证明该方法的通用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于非参数贝叶斯框架的重构方法，利用级联失效数据反向推导相互依赖的复杂基础设施网络拓扑，解决了因隐私限制而导致的数据缺失问题，并显著提升了重构的效率与准确性。
AI.keywords: 相互依赖网络, 级联失效, 贝叶斯推断, 网络重构, 关键基础设施
AI.comments: 该研究解决了基础设施网络拓扑数据缺失及隐私保护的难题，通过级联失效数据反向推演网络结构。其创新之处在于利用非参数贝叶斯方法与高效的采样算法，在准确性和计算效率上均有显著提升，具有重要的工程应用价值。

title: Proportionally Representative Clustering
summary: In recent years, there has been a surge in effort to formalize notions of fairness in machine learning. We focus on centroid clustering--one of the fundamental tasks in unsupervised machine learning. We propose a new axiom ``proportionally representative fairness'' (PRF) that is designed for clustering problems where the selection of centroids reflects the distribution of data points and how tightly they are clustered together. Our fairness concept is not satisfied by existing fair clustering algorithms. We design efficient algorithms to achieve PRF both for unconstrained and discrete clustering problems. Our algorithm for the unconstrained setting is also the first known polynomial-time approximation algorithm for the well-studied Proportional Fairness (PF) axiom. Our algorithm for the discrete setting also matches the best known approximation factor for PF.

title: Unveiling the Unborn: Advancing Fetal Health Classification through Machine Learning
summary: Fetal health classification is a critical task in obstetrics, enabling early identification and management of potential health problems. However, it remains challenging due to data complexity and limited labeled samples. This research paper presents a novel machine-learning approach for fetal health classification, leveraging a LightGBM classifier trained on a comprehensive dataset. The proposed model achieves an impressive accuracy of 98.31% on a test set. Our findings demonstrate the potential of machine learning in enhancing fetal health classification, offering a more objective and accurate assessment. Notably, our approach combines various features, such as fetal heart rate, uterine contractions, and maternal blood pressure, to provide a comprehensive evaluation. This methodology holds promise for improving early detection and treatment of fetal health issues, ensuring better outcomes for both mothers and babies. Beyond the high accuracy achieved, the novelty of our approach lies in its comprehensive feature selection and assessment methodology. By incorporating multiple data points, our model offers a more holistic and reliable evaluation compared to traditional methods. This research has significant implications in the field of obstetrics, paving the way for advancements in early detection and intervention of fetal health concerns. Future work involves validating the model on a larger dataset and developing a clinical application. Ultimately, we anticipate that our research will revolutionize the assessment and management of fetal health, contributing to improved healthcare outcomes for expectant mothers and their babies.

AI.title_translation: 揭示未出生者：通过机器学习推进胎儿健康分类研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LightGBM的机器学习方法，通过综合多项生理指标，以98.31%的准确率实现了高效的胎儿健康分类。
AI.motivation: 针对胎儿健康分类任务中存在的数据复杂性和标注样本有限的挑战，旨在提升评估的客观性与准确性，以实现更早期的检测与干预。
AI.method: 采用LightGBM分类器，通过整合胎心率、宫缩和母体血压等多种临床特征进行多维度建模与评估。
AI.result: 该模型在测试集上达到了98.31%的准确率，证明了其在胎儿健康评估方面的卓越性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了基于LightGBM的机器学习模型能够显著提高胎儿健康分类的准确性，为临床早期干预提供了可靠的辅助评估工具。
AI.translation: 胎儿健康分类是产科领域的一项关键任务，有助于早期发现和管理潜在的健康问题。然而，由于数据复杂性和标注样本有限，该任务仍具挑战性。本研究提出了一种用于胎儿健康分类的创新机器学习方法，利用在综合数据集上训练的LightGBM分类器。所提出的模型在测试集上达到了98.31%的优异准确率。我们的研究结果证明了机器学习在增强胎儿健康分类方面的潜力，提供了更客观、准确的评估。值得注意的是，我们的方法结合了多种特征，如胎心率、宫缩和母体血压，以提供全面评估。该方法有望改善胎儿健康问题的早期发现和治疗，确保母亲和婴儿获得更好的预后。除了实现高准确率外，我们方法的创新之处在于其全面的特征选择和评估方法。通过结合多个数据点，与传统方法相比，我们的模型提供了更全面、更可靠的评估。这项研究在产科领域具有重要意义，为胎儿健康问题的早期检测和干预进展铺平了道路。未来的工作包括在更大的数据集上验证模型并开发临床应用。最终，我们预计我们的研究将彻底改变胎儿健康的评估和管理，为准妈妈及其婴儿带来更好的医疗成果。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用LightGBM模型进行胎儿健康分类的新方法。通过整合胎心率、宫缩及母体血压等关键生理特征，该模型在测试集上实现了98.31%的高准确率，为产科临床诊断提供了一种更客观、全面的评估手段。
AI.keywords: 胎儿健康分类, 机器学习, LightGBM, 产科评估, 特征工程
AI.comments: 该论文通过集成多种临床特征（如胎心率、宫缩等）利用LightGBM模型实现了极高的分类精度，展现了机器学习在产科辅助诊断中的巨大潜力。其创新点在于综合特征选择方法，提供了比传统手段更全面、客观的评估。局限性在于目前仍需在更大规模数据集上进行临床验证。

title: DIRA-SS:Dynamic Domain Incremental Regularised Adaptation -- Self-Supervised
comments: arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2205.00147
summary: Autonomous systems (AS) often rely on Deep Neural Network (DNN) classifiers to operate in complex and dynamically changing environments. However, during operation, these classifiers may encounter domains that differ from those seen during development, causing performance degradation under distribution shift. Removing systems from operation for labelled data collection and retraining is often impractical, particularly when adaptation must occur quickly and at scale. This paper introduces DIRA-SS, a self-supervised extension of Dynamic Incremental Regularised Adaptation (DIRA) that enables online domain adaptation using only a small number of unlabelled target-domain samples. DIRA-SS augments an existing classifier with an auxiliary retraining branch and adapts the shared feature representation through a rotation-prediction task, while elastic weight consolidation regularises important source-domain parameters to reduce destructive updates. This allows the model to benefit from transfer learning without requiring classification labels during operation. We evaluate DIRA-SS on CIFAR-10C, CIFAR-100C, and ImageNet-C using ResNet architectures under severe common corruptions. The results show that DIRA-SS substantially improves performance over the non-adapted source model, achieves accuracy close to the supervised DIRA method, and outperforms existing unsupervised test-time adaptation baselines on ImageNet-C when using only 100 target-domain samples.

AI.title_translation: DIRA-SS：动态领域增量正则化适应——自监督学习版
AI.tldr: DIRA-SS 是一种无需标签的在线领域适应技术，通过自监督旋转任务和正则化，使模型在极少量样本下即可适应动态环境中的分布偏移。
AI.motivation: 自主系统在运行中常遇到分布偏移导致的性能下降，而传统的收集标签数据进行重新训练的方法在实际应用中既不切实际也不高效。
AI.method: DIRA-SS 引入了一个辅助重训练分支，通过自监督的旋转预测任务来适应共享特征表示，并利用弹性权重固化（EWC）来正则化重要的源域参数，从而防止灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10C、CIFAR-100C 和 ImageNet-C 等数据集上，DIRA-SS 相比未适应的源模型有显著提升，性能接近监督式 DIRA，并在仅使用 100 个无标签样本时超过了现有的无监督测试时适应基准。
AI.conclusion: DIRA-SS 是一种高效的自监督在线领域适应方法，能够通过极少量的无标签数据显著提升模型在动态环境下的鲁棒性，且性能表现接近监督式学习方法。
AI.translation: 自主系统（AS）通常依赖深度神经网络（DNN）分类器在复杂和动态变化的环境中运行。然而，在运行过程中，这些分类器可能会遇到与开发阶段所见不同的领域，从而导致分布偏移下的性能下降。将系统从运行中移除以进行标签数据收集和重训练通常是不切实际的，特别是在必须快速且大规模进行适应的情况下。本文介绍了 DIRA-SS，这是动态增量正则化适应（DIRA）的一种自监督扩展，它仅使用少量无标签目标域样本即可实现在线领域适应。DIRA-SS 通过辅助重训练分支增强现有分类器，并通过旋转预测任务适应共享特征表示，同时利用弹性权重固化来正则化重要的源域参数，以减少破坏性更新。这使得模型能够在运行期间受益于迁移学习，而无需分类标签。我们在严重常见损坏下的 ResNet 架构上，使用 CIFAR-10C、CIFAR-100C 和 ImageNet-C 对 DIRA-SS 进行了评估。结果表明，DIRA-SS 显著提高了相对于未适应源模型的性能，达到了接近监督式 DIRA 方法的准确度，并且在仅使用 100 个目标域样本时，在 ImageNet-C 上优于现有的无监督测试时适应基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 DIRA-SS 的自监督在线领域适应方法，旨在解决自主系统在动态环境中面临的分布偏移问题。该方法通过辅助训练分支和旋转预测任务，在无需标签的情况下利用少量目标域数据进行模型更新，并结合正则化手段减少参数破坏，实现了高效的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 在线领域适应, 自监督学习, 弹性权重固化, 深度神经网络, 动态环境
AI.comments: DIRA-SS 的创新之处在于将自监督学习（旋转预测任务）与正则化技术（弹性权重固化）相结合，实现了在无需标注数据情况下的高效在线领域适应。它成功解决了自主系统在动态环境中面临的性能衰退问题，且在数据样本量极少的情况下表现优异。局限性在于主要针对特定图像分类任务进行验证，在更复杂或非视觉任务中的泛化能力有待进一步研究。

title: Interpretable factorization of clinical questionnaires to identify latent factors of psychopathology
summary: Psychiatry research seeks to understand the manifestations of psychopathology in behavior, as measured in questionnaire data, by identifying a small number of latent factors that explain them. While factor analysis is the canonical tool for this purpose, the resulting factors may not be interpretable, and may also be subject to confounding variables. Moreover, missing data are common, and explicit imputation is often required. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Interpretability Constrained Questionnaire Factorization (ICQF), a non-negative matrix factorization method with regularization tailored for questionnaire data. Our method aims to promote factor interpretability and solution stability. We provide an optimization procedure with theoretical convergence guarantees, and an automated procedure to determine latent dimensionality accurately. We validate these procedures using realistic synthetic data. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in a widely used general-purpose questionnaire, in two independent datasets (the Healthy Brain Network and Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development studies). Specifically, we show that ICQF preserves diagnostic information across a range of disorders, outperforming competing methods for smaller dataset sizes, and improves interpretability, as assessed by our clinical research collaborators and co-authors. This suggests that the regularization in our method matches domain characteristics, in addition to satisfying qualitative desiderata.

AI.title_translation: 临床问卷的可解释因子分解：识别心理病理学的潜在因素
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新型问卷因子分解方法（ICQF），通过引入可解释性约束，更准确地提取心理病理学特征，并在临床数据集上验证了其优于传统方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的因子分析在处理精神病学问卷数据时，存在结果可解释性差、易受混杂变量干扰以及难以处理缺失数据等问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“可解释性约束问卷因子分解”（ICQF）的非负矩阵分解方法，通过引入专门针对问卷数据的正则化手段，并配套了理论收敛保证及自动确定潜在维度的程序。
AI.result: 在真实合成数据及两个大型公开数据集（HBN 和 ABCD）上的实验表明，ICQF 在保持诊断信息的同时，提升了结果的可解释性，并在小样本数据集上优于现有竞争方法。
AI.conclusion: ICQF 是一种针对临床问卷数据的有效因子分解方法，通过可解释性约束和自动降维，能够更好地捕捉心理病理学的潜在因素，并在小样本数据上表现优异，具有良好的临床应用前景。
AI.translation: 精神病学研究试图通过识别少量解释行为的潜在因子来理解心理病理学的表现，这些表现通常由问卷数据测量。虽然因子分析是实现这一目的的标准工具，但产生的因子可能不具备可解释性，且可能受到混杂变量的影响。此外，缺失数据很常见，通常需要明确的插补。为了克服这些限制，我们引入了可解释性约束问卷因子分解（ICQF），这是一种针对问卷数据量身定制的、带有正则化的非负矩阵分解方法。我们的方法旨在提升因子的可解释性和解决方案的稳定性。我们提供了一种具有理论收敛保证的优化程序，以及一种准确确定潜在维度的自动化程序。我们使用真实的合成数据验证了这些程序。我们在两个独立数据集（健康大脑网络和青少年大脑认知发展研究）中，通过一份广泛使用的通用问卷证明了我们方法的有效性。具体而言，我们表明 ICQF 保留了一系列疾病的诊断信息，在较小的数据集规模上优于竞争方法，并提升了可解释性，这得到了我们的临床研究合作者和合著者的评估。这表明我们方法中的正则化不仅满足了定性需求，还与领域特征相匹配。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 ICQF 的非负矩阵分解方法，专门用于从临床问卷数据中提取具有可解释性的心理病理学潜在因子。该方法通过引入特定的正则化技术和自动化维度确定流程，克服了传统因子分析在可解释性、稳定性及数据处理方面的限制，并在多个数据集上验证了其优越的临床效用。
AI.keywords: 心理病理学, 问卷分析, 非负矩阵分解, 可解释性, 潜在因子
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入可解释性约束，有效解决了传统因子分析在临床问卷应用中存在的可解释性差、易受混杂因素影响以及对缺失数据处理不当的问题。其创新之处在于将领域知识融入正则化项，在保证数学收敛性的同时提升了临床意义，对于心理病理学研究具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users
comments: Accepted to CHI 2025, project page is https://appagent-official.github.io/
summary: Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have led to the creation of intelligent agents capable of performing complex tasks. This paper introduces a novel LLM-based multimodal agent framework designed to operate smartphone applications. Our framework enables the agent to operate smartphone applications through a simplified action space, mimicking human-like interactions such as tapping and swiping. This novel approach bypasses the need for system back-end access, thereby broadening its applicability across diverse apps. Central to our agent's functionality is its innovative learning method. The agent learns to navigate and use new apps either through autonomous exploration or by observing human demonstrations. This process generates a knowledge base that the agent refers to for executing complex tasks across different applications. To demonstrate the practicality of our agent, we conducted extensive testing over 50 tasks in 10 different applications, including social media, email, maps, shopping, and sophisticated image editing tools. The results affirm our agent's proficiency in handling a diverse array of high-level tasks.
comment: Accepted to CHI 2025, project page is https://appagent-official.github.io/

AI.title_translation: AppAgent：作为智能手机用户的多模态智能体
AI.tldr: AppAgent是一个不需要后端权限的智能手机操作助手，通过模仿人类行为和学习应用操作，能够高效完成各类手机应用任务。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决当前智能体难以跨应用执行复杂任务的问题，并克服需要访问系统后端权限的局限性，实现像人类一样操作手机应用。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于大语言模型的多模态智能体框架，通过简化操作空间（点击、滑动）模拟人类交互；利用自主探索和人类演示学习应用操作，并建立知识库以执行复杂任务。
AI.result: 在涵盖社交媒体、邮件、地图、购物及图像编辑等10个应用上的50多项任务测试中，该智能体表现出了卓越的复杂任务处理能力。
AI.conclusion: AppAgent证明了多模态大模型能够通过观察和自主探索，有效地模拟人类操作手机应用，为实现通用手机智能体提供了可行的路径。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展催生了能够执行复杂任务的智能智能体。本文介绍了一种基于LLM的新型多模态智能体框架，旨在操作智能手机应用程序。我们的框架使智能体能够通过简化的动作空间（模拟人类的点击和滑动）来操作手机应用。这种新颖的方法绕过了对系统后端访问的需求，从而扩大了其在不同应用中的适用性。该智能体功能的核心在于其创新的学习方法。智能体通过自主探索或观察人类演示来学习导航和使用新应用程序。这个过程生成了一个知识库，智能体参考该知识库在不同应用程序中执行复杂任务。为了证明我们智能体的实用性，我们在10个不同的应用程序中进行了50多项任务的广泛测试，包括社交媒体、电子邮件、地图、购物和复杂的图像编辑工具。结果证实了我们的智能体在处理各种高级任务方面的熟练程度。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的多模态智能体框架AppAgent，通过模拟人类点击和滑动操作来控制手机应用，无需后端权限。智能体通过自主探索和观察人类演示学习并构建知识库，成功在多种应用场景中完成了复杂的跨应用任务。
AI.keywords: 多模态智能体, 大语言模型, 智能手机应用, 模仿学习, 自主探索
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于通过模仿人类操作（点击、滑动）而非依赖后端API来控制手机应用，这极大地提高了通用性。其学习机制（自主探索与模仿学习）使其具有良好的扩展性。局限性在于未提及在极度复杂或动态环境下的鲁棒性表现。

title: Learning to Visually Connect Actions and their Effects
comments: WACV 2025 (Two Reviewer Nominations for Best Paper Candidate; Oral Presentation)
summary: We introduce the novel concept of visually Connecting Actions and Their Effects (CATE) in video understanding. CATE can have applications in areas like task planning and learning from demonstration. We identify and explore two different aspects of the concept of CATE: Action Selection (AS) and Effect-Affinity Assessment (EAA), where video understanding models connect actions and effects at semantic and fine-grained levels, respectively. We design various baseline models for AS and EAA. Despite the intuitive nature of the task, we observe that models struggle, and humans outperform them by a large margin. Our experiments show that in solving AS and EAA, models learn intuitive properties like object tracking and pose encoding without explicit supervision. We demonstrate that CATE can be an effective self-supervised task for learning video representations from unlabeled videos. The study aims to showcase the fundamental nature and versatility of CATE, with the hope of inspiring advanced formulations and models.
comment: WACV 2025 (Two Reviewer Nominations for Best Paper Candidate; Oral Presentation)

AI.title_translation: 学习在视觉上连接动作及其效果
AI.tldr: 本文引入了CATE概念来连接视频中的动作与效果，并证明了通过解决动作选择与效果评估任务，模型可以在无需显式监督的情况下学习到高质量的视频表征。
AI.motivation: 当前视频理解领域缺乏对动作及其产生效果之间逻辑关联的显式建模，该研究旨在通过引入CATE概念，提升模型在任务规划和从示范中学习等领域的表现。
AI.method: 作者定义了两个子任务：动作选择（AS，语义层面）和效果亲和力评估（EAA，细粒度层面），并设计了多种基线模型来执行这些任务，同时验证了其作为自监督学习任务在未标注视频中的表现。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管人类在这些任务上表现远超机器，但模型通过解决AS和EAA任务，能够自发学习到物体跟踪和姿态编码等 intuitive 属性，且CATE可作为一种有效的自监督预训练任务。
AI.conclusion: CATE是一个基础且多功能的视频理解任务。实验证明，即使在没有显式监督的情况下，通过解决AS和EAA任务，模型也能学习到强大的视频特征，这为未来的视频表征学习研究提供了新的自监督学习范式。
AI.translation: 我们在视频理解中引入了“连接动作及其效果”（CATE）这一新概念。CATE在任务规划和从示范中学习等领域具有应用前景。我们识别并探索了CATE概念的两个不同方面：动作选择（AS）和效果亲和力评估（EAA），视频理解模型分别在语义层面和细粒度层面连接动作与效果。我们为AS和EAA设计了各种基线模型。尽管该任务在直觉上很直观，但我们观察到模型表现挣扎，人类的表现远超模型。我们的实验表明，在解决AS和EAA问题时，模型无需显式监督就能学习到物体跟踪和姿态编码等直观属性。我们证明了CATE可以成为一种有效的自监督任务，用于从无标注视频中学习视频表征。本研究旨在展示CATE的基础性和多功能性，希望能激发更先进的模型构思。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“连接动作及其效果”（CATE）的新概念，旨在通过动作选择（AS）和效果亲和力评估（EAA）两个维度提升视频理解能力。研究发现该任务不仅能评估模型对动作逻辑的理解，还能作为有效的自监督学习手段，帮助模型在无标注视频中习得关键特征。
AI.keywords: 视频理解, 动作与效果, 自监督学习, 动作选择, 效果亲和力评估
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个新颖的视觉任务框架，通过连接动作及其效果来促进视频理解。创新点在于将任务细分为语义层面的动作选择（AS）和细粒度层面的效果亲和力评估（EAA）。该研究不仅揭示了当前模型在这些任务上的局限性，还证明了CATE作为一种有效的自监督学习任务，能够让模型在无需显式标注的情况下学习到物体跟踪和姿态编码等关键特征，对于视频表征学习具有重要意义。

title: TERC: A Transfer Entropy Redundancy Criterion for State Variable Selection in Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Identifying the most suitable variables to represent the state is a fundamental challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL). These variables must efficiently capture the information necessary for making optimal decisions. In order to address this problem, in this paper, we introduce the Transfer Entropy Redundancy Criterion (TERC), an information-theoretic criterion, which determines if there is entropy transferred from observable state variables to actions during training. We define an algorithm based on TERC that provably excludes variables from the observable state that do not affect the agent's policy during learning. This yields compact state representations that reduce inference time by up to 2.6 times. Our approach is policy-dependent, making it agnostic to the underlying learning algorithm. The efficiency gains we demonstrate arise at retraining and inference time on the reduced state.
  Our method improves both retraining and inference efficiency. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three distinct algorithm classes, namely tabular Q-learning, Actor-Critic, and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), evaluated in a range of environments. Furthermore, to highlight the differences between the proposed methodology and the current state-of-the-art feature selection approaches, we present a series of controlled experiments on synthetic data, before generalizing to real-world decision-making tasks. We also introduce a representation of the problem that compactly captures the transfer of information from observable state variables to actions as Bayesian networks.

AI.title_translation: TERC：强化学习中状态变量选择的迁移熵冗余准则
AI.tldr: 本文提出 TERC 准则，通过识别并剔除强化学习中对决策无贡献的冗余状态变量，显著提升了模型推理和重训练的效率。
AI.motivation: 在强化学习中，如何从可观测变量中识别出对制定最优决策至关重要的状态变量是一个核心挑战，旨在减少冗余变量以提升推理和训练效率。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于信息论的迁移熵冗余准则（TERC），通过量化从可观测状态变量到动作的熵转移，识别并排除对策略无影响的变量，并利用贝叶斯网络对信息转移进行建模。
AI.result: 实验表明，TERC 可将推理时间减少至多 2.6 倍，且在 Q-learning、Actor-Critic 和 PPO 等多种算法及不同环境下均表现出显著的效率提升。
AI.conclusion: TERC 是一种有效的、与具体学习算法无关的状态变量选择准则，能够显著压缩状态表示，从而提升强化学习模型在重训练和推理阶段的效率。
AI.translation: 识别最适合表示状态的变量是强化学习（RL）中的一个基本挑战。这些变量必须有效地捕获制定最优决策所需的信息。为了解决这个问题，本文引入了迁移熵冗余准则（TERC），这是一种信息论准则，用于确定在训练过程中是否有熵从可观测状态变量转移到动作。我们定义了一种基于 TERC 的算法，该算法可以从可观测状态中排除在学习过程中不影响智能体策略的变量。这产生了紧凑的状态表示，将推理时间减少了多达 2.6 倍。我们的方法依赖于策略，因此不依赖于底层的学习算法。我们展示的效率增益出现在重训练和缩减状态后的推理阶段。我们的方法提高了重训练和推理的效率。我们在三种不同的算法类别（即表格 Q-learning、Actor-Critic 和近端策略优化（PPO））中证明了其有效性，并在各种环境中进行了评估。此外，为了突出所提方法与当前最先进的特征选择方法之间的差异，我们对合成数据进行了一系列对照实验，并推广到现实世界的决策任务中。我们还引入了一种问题表示，将从可观测状态变量到动作的信息转移紧凑地捕获为贝叶斯网络。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 TERC 的信息论准则，用于在强化学习中选择关键状态变量。该方法通过度量状态变量到动作的熵转移来剔除冗余变量，生成紧凑的状态表示，从而在保持策略性能的同时，显著提升了算法的训练和推理效率。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 状态变量选择, 迁移熵, 信息论, 效率优化
AI.comments: 该论文通过信息论方法解决强化学习中的状态变量选择问题，具有较强的普适性。其创新点在于利用迁移熵（Transfer Entropy）来量化变量对决策的贡献，从而精简状态空间。局限性在于对复杂非线性环境下的计算开销可能随变量增加而增长，且依赖于训练过程中的轨迹数据。

title: Graph Unitary Message Passing
summary: Unitarity is a useful principle for stabilizing deep neural networks, but in graph neural networks (GNNs) instability is induced not only by learnable parameters but also by the graph propagation operator. Motivated by this distinction, we propose Graph Unitary Message Passing (GUMP), a message-passing framework that uses a unitary propagation operator on a transformed graph to avoid graph-induced exponential decay under repeated propagation. GUMP combines (i) a graph transformation that maps an input graph to an Eulerian line-graph construction admitting unitary adjacency matrices, and (ii) a practical unitary projection procedure based on Newton-Schulz iteration. Theoretical analysis clarifies that, under standard analysis assumptions, unitary propagation keeps the graph-propagation term depth-stable, while vanilla normalized propagation exhibits exponential decay in its non-trivial spectral components. Across synthetic long-range tasks, TUDataset benchmarks, and LRGB datasets, GUMP improves over vanilla message passing and achieves competitive or superior performance against strong baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/ucker/gump_code.

AI.tldr: GUMP 框架通过确保图传播算子的酉性质，解决了深度图神经网络中的信号衰减问题，显著提升了模型在长距离任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 深度图神经网络的不稳定性不仅源于可学习参数，还受到图传播算子的影响。现有的消息传递机制在重复传播过程中会导致图诱导的指数衰减，限制了深度模型的性能。
AI.method: 提出了图酉消息传递（GUMP）框架，包含两个核心步骤：1. 通过图变换将原始图映射为允许酉邻接矩阵的欧拉线图；2. 采用基于 Newton-Schulz 迭代的实用酉投影程序来保持传播过程的稳定性。
AI.result: 理论分析证明 GUMP 能保持传播项的深度稳定性。实验结果表明，GUMP 在合成长距离任务、TUDataset 和 LRGB 数据集上均优于普通的图消息传递方法，并达到了与强基线模型相当或更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: GUMP 通过确保传播算子的酉性质，有效解决了深度图神经网络中的信号衰减问题，实现了更稳定的深度模型训练，并在多项基准测试中展现了优越性能。
AI.translation: 酉性是稳定深度神经网络的一个有用原则，但在图神经网络（GNN）中，不稳定性不仅由可学习参数引起，还由图传播算子引起。基于这一区别，我们提出了图酉消息传递（GUMP），这是一种在变换图上使用酉传播算子的消息传递框架，旨在避免重复传播下由图引起的指数衰减。GUMP 结合了（i）一种将输入图映射为允许酉邻接矩阵的欧拉线图的图变换，以及（ii）一种基于 Newton-Schulz 迭代的实用酉投影程序。理论分析阐明，在标准假设下，酉传播使图传播项保持深度稳定，而普通的归一化传播在非平凡谱分量中表现出指数衰减。在合成长距离任务、TUDataset 基准和 LRGB 数据集中，GUMP 优于普通的图消息传递，并取得了与强基线相当或更好的性能。代码已在 https://github.com/ucker/gump_code 提供。
AI.summary: 本文提出了图酉消息传递（GUMP）框架，通过引入酉传播算子解决了深度图神经网络中常见的图诱导指数衰减问题。GUMP 利用图变换和 Newton-Schulz 迭代实现酉投影，确保了深度传播的稳定性，并在多个基准测试中验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 图神经网络, 酉传播, 图变换, 深度稳定性, 消息传递
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将酉矩阵约束引入到图神经网络的传播算子中，解决了深度GNN中常见的图诱导指数衰减问题。其方法结合了图变换（线图）与高效的投影算法，具有很强的理论支撑，在长距离依赖任务中表现出色。

title: Computational Complexity of the Recoverable Robust Shortest Path Problem with Discrete Recourse
summary: In this paper the recoverable robust shortest path problem is investigated. Discrete budgeted interval uncertainty representation is used to model uncertain second-stage arc costs. The known complexity results for this problem are strengthened. It is shown that it is Sigma_3^p-hard for the arc exclusion and the arc symmetric difference neighborhoods. Furthermore, it is also proven that the inner adversarial problem for these neighborhoods is Pi_2^p-hard.

AI.title_translation: 具有离散追索的可恢复鲁棒最短路径问题的计算复杂度
AI.tldr: 本文证明了带离散追索的可恢复鲁棒最短路径问题在特定邻域下属于Sigma_3^p-hard，揭示了其极高的计算难度。
AI.motivation: 为了更精确地刻画具有离散追索的可恢复鲁棒最短路径问题的计算复杂性。
AI.method: 利用离散预算区间不确定性模型，针对弧排除和弧对称差邻域进行计算复杂度分析，并证明了内部对抗问题的Pi_2^p-hard性质。
AI.result: 证明了该问题在弧排除和弧对称差邻域下是Sigma_3^p-hard的，且其内部对抗问题是Pi_2^p-hard的。
AI.conclusion: 确定了可恢复鲁棒最短路径问题在特定邻域下的计算复杂度下界，证明了其属于极高复杂性类。
AI.translation: 本文研究了可恢复鲁棒最短路径问题。使用离散预算区间不确定性表示来模拟不确定的第二阶段弧成本。强化了该问题的已知复杂度结果。结果表明，对于弧排除和弧对称差邻域，该问题是Sigma_3^p-hard的。此外，还证明了这些邻域的内部对抗问题是Pi_2^p-hard的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了具有离散追索的可恢复鲁棒最短路径问题，采用离散预算区间不确定性建模。研究结果强化了该问题的计算复杂度结论，证明了其在弧排除和弧对称差邻域下具有Sigma_3^p-hard的复杂性，且内部对抗问题为Pi_2^p-hard。
AI.keywords: 可恢复鲁棒最短路径, 计算复杂度, 离散预算不确定性, Sigma_3^p-hard, Pi_2^p-hard
AI.comments: 该论文通过证明其属于Sigma_3^p-hard和Pi_2^p-hard，显著提升了对该问题的复杂度认识，为后续算法设计提供了重要的理论边界。

title: CausalChaos! Dataset for Comprehensive Causal Action Question Answering Over Longer Causal Chains Grounded in Dynamic Visual Scenes
summary: Causal video question answering (QA) has garnered increasing interest, yet existing datasets often lack depth in causal reasoning. To address this gap, we capitalize on the unique properties of cartoons and construct CausalChaos!, a novel, challenging causal Why-QA dataset built upon the iconic "Tom and Jerry" cartoon series. Cartoons use the principles of animation that allow animators to create expressive, unambiguous causal relationships between events to form a coherent storyline. Utilizing these properties, along with thought-provoking questions and multi-level answers (answer and detailed causal explanation), our questions involve causal chains that interconnect multiple dynamic interactions between characters and visual scenes. These factors demand models to solve more challenging, yet well-defined causal relationships. We also introduce hard incorrect answer mining, including a causally confusing version that is even more challenging. While models perform well, there is much room for improvement, especially, on open-ended answers. We identify more advanced/explicit causal relationship modeling & joint modeling of vision and language as the immediate areas for future efforts to focus upon. Along with the other complementary datasets, our new challenging dataset will pave the way for these developments in the field. Project Page: https://github.com/LUNAProject22/CausalChaos

AI.title_translation: CausalChaos!：用于在动态视觉场景中进行更长因果链全面因果动作问答的数据集
AI.tldr: CausalChaos! 是一个基于动画构建的视频问答数据集，通过复杂的长链因果问题和难负样本，旨在提升模型在动态视觉场景下的深度因果推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视频因果问答数据集缺乏深度因果推理能力，无法有效评估模型在处理长链、动态视觉场景下的复杂因果关系。
AI.method: 利用“汤姆猫与杰瑞鼠”动画构建数据集，设计涉及多动态交互的长链因果问题，并引入难负样本挖掘（包括因果混淆版本）来评估模型的因果推理能力。
AI.result: 实验表明，虽然模型在现有任务上表现尚可，但在处理开放式回答时仍有巨大提升空间，且在处理复杂的长链因果关系时面临显著挑战。
AI.conclusion: CausalChaos! 数据集通过复杂的长链因果视频问答任务，揭示了当前多模态模型在深度因果推理方面的不足，为未来探索更高级的因果建模和视觉语言联合建模指明了方向。
AI.translation: 因果视频问答（QA）引起了越来越多的关注，但现有的数据集往往缺乏因果推理的深度。为了填补这一空白，我们利用卡通的独特属性，基于标志性的“汤姆猫与杰瑞鼠”系列构建了一个新颖且具有挑战性的因果 Why-QA 数据集：CausalChaos!。卡通利用动画原理，使动画师能够创建事件之间明确且富有表现力的因果关系，从而形成连贯的故事情节。利用这些属性，加上发人深省的问题和多层级答案（答案和详细的因果解释），我们的问题涉及连接角色与视觉场景之间多个动态交互的因果链。这些因素要求模型解决更具挑战性且定义明确的因果关系。我们还引入了困难的错误答案挖掘，包括一个更具挑战性的因果混淆版本。虽然模型表现良好，但仍有很大的改进空间，特别是在开放式回答方面。我们确定了更先进/明确的因果关系建模以及视觉和语言的联合建模作为未来工作的重点领域。连同其他互补数据集，我们的新挑战性数据集将为该领域的这些发展铺平道路。项目主页：https://github.com/LUNAProject22/CausalChaos
AI.summary: 本文提出了 CausalChaos! 数据集，这是一个基于“汤姆猫与杰瑞鼠”动画构建的视频问答数据集，专注于长链因果推理。该数据集利用动画清晰的因果逻辑，通过多层级答案和难负样本挖掘，旨在推动视频理解模型在复杂因果关系建模及视觉语言联合推理方面的发展。
AI.keywords: 视频问答, 因果推理, 数据集, 计算机视觉, 多模态学习
AI.comments: 该数据集的创新之处在于利用卡通（汤姆猫与杰瑞鼠）中清晰且富有表现力的因果关系来构建更具挑战性的因果推理任务。通过引入多层级的因果解释和难负样本挖掘，该研究为视频因果问答模型的发展提供了新的评估基准和挑战。其局限在于目前模型在开放式回答方面表现仍有待提升。

title: Merchants of Vulnerabilities: How Bug Bounty Programs Benefit Software Vendors
comments: Publisher: SAGE Publications. Production and Operations Management (2026)
summary: We study how bug bounty programs (BBPs) shape software vendors' security and release choices. We develop a game-theoretic model in which a vendor chooses release timing and severity-contingent bounties, anticipating effort by ethical and malicious hackers in a winner-take-all discovery race. The model highlights two linked mechanisms: an incentive channel that shifts first discovery of severe vulnerabilities away from malicious exploitation and toward ethical reporting, and a governance channel in which coordinated disclosure changes how vulnerability information is managed during remediation. We derive closed-form optimal bounties and characterize a feasibility region sustaining positive bounties and interior success probabilities. Within it, a BBP strictly increases the vendor's expected profit by reallocating first-discovery probability on severe vulnerabilities from malicious to ethical hackers and by converting part of severe-loss exposure into bounded, pay-for-results expenditures. For private programs, we solve for the optimal invited set of ethical hackers and show it is strictly smaller than the expected number of malicious attackers. Higher bounties raise ethical hackers' effort and first-discovery probabilities but also increase program cost, and interact with reputational (non-monetary) incentives. Finally, BBP adoption conditionally reduces the marginal value of additional pre-release delay, implying earlier release relative to the no-BBP benchmark. Managerially, BBPs should be viewed as a post-release governance layer complementing strong internal assurance rather than a substitute for it. Policymakers can support responsible use by encouraging timely remediation, transparent post-patch disclosure, and reporting standards that reduce information asymmetry and triage frictions. (Abstract edited to fit the arXiv length limit.)

AI.title_translation: 漏洞商人：漏洞赏金计划如何使软件厂商受益
AI.tldr: 漏洞赏金计划通过经济激励将漏洞发现权从恶意黑客转移给伦理黑客，从而帮助厂商降低风险、增加利润并优化软件发布节奏。
AI.motivation: 研究漏洞赏金计划（BBP）如何影响软件厂商的安全决策和产品发布时机，揭示其在减少恶意利用和优化漏洞修复治理方面的经济价值。
AI.method: 构建了一个博弈论模型，模拟软件厂商在发布时间与赏金定价上的决策，并分析了伦理黑客与恶意攻击者在“胜者全得”机制下的竞争行为。
AI.result: 研究表明，BBP能通过将严重漏洞的发现概率从恶意黑客转移到伦理黑客，从而提高厂商利润；BBP还能促使厂商更早发布产品，并为私有项目提供了最优邀请人数的理论解。
AI.conclusion: BBP是软件厂商提升安全性和利润的有效工具，它通过将恶意利用转化为受控的付费报告，优化了漏洞修复过程。厂商应将其作为内部安全审查的补充，而非替代品。
AI.translation: 我们研究了漏洞赏金计划（BBP）如何塑造软件厂商的安全和发布选择。我们开发了一个博弈论模型，其中厂商在预期伦理黑客和恶意黑客进行“胜者全得”的发现竞赛的情况下，选择发布时间和基于严重程度的赏金。该模型突出了两个相互关联的机制：一个是将严重漏洞的首发发现从恶意利用转向伦理报告的激励渠道；另一个是协调披露改变漏洞信息在修复过程中管理方式的治理渠道。我们推导出了封闭形式的最优赏金，并表征了维持正赏金和内部成功概率的可行区域。在该区域内，BBP通过将严重漏洞的首发概率从恶意黑客重新分配给伦理黑客，并将部分严重损失风险转化为有限的、按结果付费的支出，从而严格增加了厂商的预期利润。对于私有项目，我们求解了伦理黑客的最优邀请集，并证明其严格小于预期恶意攻击者的数量。更高的赏金会提高伦理黑客的努力程度和首发概率，但也会增加计划成本，并与声誉（非货币）激励相互作用。最后，BBP的采用有条件地降低了额外预发布延迟的边际价值，意味着相对于无BBP基准，产品发布时间更早。在管理上，BBP应被视为补充强大的内部保证的发布后治理层，而不是替代品。政策制定者可以通过鼓励及时修复、透明的补丁后披露以及减少信息不对称和分类摩擦的报告标准来支持其负责任的使用。
AI.summary: 本文通过博弈论模型探讨了漏洞赏金计划（BBP）对软件厂商的影响。研究发现，BBP通过激励机制引导伦理黑客优先发现漏洞，并利用治理机制改善漏洞修复过程。结果显示，BBP在提高厂商利润、缩短产品上市时间以及有效管理严重漏洞风险方面具有显著优势。
AI.keywords: 漏洞赏金计划, 博弈论, 软件安全, 漏洞披露, 激励机制
AI.comments: 该论文通过博弈论视角深入剖析了漏洞赏金计划（BBP）的经济学机制，创新点在于同时考虑了激励机制（防范恶意利用）与治理机制（协调披露）。其重要性在于为厂商提供了关于赏金定价及私有项目规模的量化指导，明确了BBP在软件开发生命周期中的定位。局限性在于模型基于理论假设，未讨论黑客行为的复杂动态或特定行业差异。

title: Metric Differential Privacy at the User-Level Via the Earth Mover's Distance
comments: 46 pages, 2 tables. Appeared in ACM CCS 2024
summary:
Metric differential privacy (DP) provides heterogeneous privacy guarantees based on a distance between the pair of inputs. It is a widely popular notion of privacy since it captures the natural privacy semantics for many applications (such as, for location data) and results in better utility than standard DP. However, prior work in metric DP has primarily focused on the item-level setting where every user only reports a single data item. A more realistic setting is that of user-level DP where each user contributes multiple items and privacy is then desired at the granularity of the user's entire contribution. In this paper, we initiate the study of one natural definition of metric DP at the user-level. Specifically, we use the earth-mover's distance ($d_\textsf{EM}$) as our metric to obtain a notion of privacy as it captures both the magnitude and spatial aspects of changes in a user's data.
  We make three main technical contributions. First, we design two novel mechanisms under $d_\textsf{EM}$-DP to answer linear queries and item-wise queries. Specifically, our analysis for the latter involves a generalization of the privacy amplification by shuffling result which may be of independent interest. Second, we provide a black-box reduction from the general unbounded to bounded $d_\textsf{EM}$-DP (size of the dataset is fixed and public) with a novel sampling based mechanism. Third, we show that our proposed mechanisms can provably provide improved utility over user-level DP, for certain types of linear queries and frequency estimation.

AI.title_translation: 通过Earth Mover's Distance实现用户级度量差分隐私
AI.tldr: 本文将度量差分隐私扩展至用户级，利用Earth Mover's Distance实现了更优的隐私保护与数据效用平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的度量差分隐私主要集中在单项级别，无法满足现实中用户贡献多个数据项且需要用户级隐私保护的需求。
AI.method: 1. 引入Earth Mover's Distance (d_EM) 作为用户级度量隐私的距离度量；2. 设计了针对线性查询和逐项查询的两种新型机制，并推广了混洗（shuffling）隐私放大结果；3. 提出了从无界到有界d_EM-DP的黑盒归约方法，并结合了基于采样的机制。
AI.result: 所提出的机制在处理特定类型的线性查询和频率估计时，相比传统用户级差分隐私在效用上表现出显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功定义了用户级别的度量差分隐私，并证明了基于Earth Mover's Distance的机制在特定查询任务中比传统用户级差分隐私具有更好的效用。
AI.translation: 度量差分隐私（DP）基于输入对之间的距离提供差异化的隐私保证。由于它能够捕捉许多应用（例如位置数据）的自然隐私语义，并比标准DP产生更好的效用，因此是一种广受欢迎的隐私概念。然而，以往的度量DP工作主要集中在单项级别，即每个用户仅报告单个数据项。更现实的场景是用户级DP，其中每个用户贡献多个数据项，并希望在用户整个贡献的粒度上实现隐私保护。在本文中，我们发起了一项关于用户级度量DP自然定义的研究。具体而言，我们使用Earth Mover's Distance (d_EM) 作为我们的度量来获得一种隐私概念，因为它捕捉了用户数据变化的幅度和空间方面。我们做出了三项主要的技术贡献。首先，我们设计了两种在d_EM-DP下的新型机制来回答线性查询和逐项查询。具体而言，我们对后者的分析涉及混洗隐私放大结果的推广，这可能具有独立的价值。其次，我们提供了一种从通用无界到有界d_EM-DP（数据集大小固定且公开）的黑盒归约，并采用了一种基于采样的新型机制。第三，我们证明了我们提出的机制在特定类型的线性查询和频率估计方面，可以证明比用户级DP提供更好的效用。
AI.summary: 本文研究了用户级别的度量差分隐私，采用Earth Mover's Distance作为距离度量以捕捉用户数据的幅度和空间变化。作者提出了针对线性查询和逐项查询的机制，开发了一种无界到有界的黑盒归约技术，并证明了这些方法在特定场景下优于传统的用户级差分隐私。
AI.keywords: 度量差分隐私, 用户级隐私, Earth Mover's Distance, 效用优化, 线性查询
AI.comments: 该研究将度量差分隐私从传统的单项级别扩展到用户级别，填补了这一领域的研究空白。利用Earth Mover's Distance作为度量标准是一个创新点，能够更好地捕捉用户贡献数据中的幅度和空间变化，为处理复杂用户数据提供了更具实用性的隐私保护框架。

title: Nonparametric Control Koopman Operators
comments: The authors' electronic preprint version of an article accepted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control
summary: This paper presents a novel Koopman composition operator representation framework for control systems in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) that is free of explicit dictionary or input parametrizations. By establishing fundamental equivalences between different model representations, we are able to close the gap of control system operator learning and infinite-dimensional regression, enabling various empirical estimators and the connection to the well-understood learning theory in RKHSs under one unified framework. Consequently, our proposed framework allows for arbitrarily accurate finite-rank approximations in infinite-dimensional spaces and leads to finite-dimensional predictors without a priori restrictions to a finite span of functions or inputs. To enable applications to high-dimensional control systems, we improve the scalability of our proposed control Koopman operator estimates by utilizing sketching techniques. Numerical experiments demonstrate superior prediction accuracy compared to bilinear EDMD, especially in high dimensions. Finally, we show that our learned models are readily interfaced with linear-parameter-varying techniques for model predictive control.
comment: The authors' electronic preprint version of an article accepted to IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于RKHS的非参数化Koopman算子学习框架，通过消除显式字典依赖并引入草图技术，实现了高精度、可扩展的控制系统建模。
AI.motivation: 现有的Koopman控制算子方法通常依赖于预定义的字典或输入参数化，限制了模型的灵活性和精度，且在高维系统中的计算可扩展性不足。
AI.method: 在再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中构建控制Koopman组合算子表示框架，利用算子表示间的等价性建立统一的学习理论，并通过草图技术（sketching）提高高维系统的可扩展性。
AI.result: 实现了在无限维空间中任意精度的有限秩逼近，在数值实验中表现出比双线性EDMD更高的预测精度，并可直接应用于线性参数变化（LPV）模型预测控制。
AI.conclusion: 该论文提出了一种非参数化的控制Koopman算子框架，实现了高精度、无显式字典依赖的系统建模，并通过草图技术有效解决了高维扩展性问题。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）中控制系统的创新Koopman组合算子表示框架，该框架无需显式字典或输入参数化。通过建立不同模型表示之间的基本等价性，我们能够弥合控制系统算子学习与无限维回归之间的差距，从而在一个统一的框架下实现各种经验估计器，并将其与RKHS中完善的学习理论联系起来。因此，我们提出的框架允许在无限维空间中进行任意精度的有限秩逼近，并导出无需先验限制函数或输入有限跨度的有限维预测器。为了实现对高维控制系统的应用，我们利用草图技术提高了所提出的控制Koopman算子估计的可扩展性。数值实验表明，与双线性EDMD相比，该方法具有更高的预测精度，特别是在高维情况下。最后，我们展示了所学习的模型可以方便地与用于模型预测控制的线性参数变化技术对接。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的非参数化控制Koopman算子框架。该方法无需预定义字典或输入参数，通过统一的理论框架实现了高精度的系统建模，并利用草图技术解决了高维系统下的可扩展性挑战。实验表明，该方法在预测精度上优于传统方法，且易于集成到模型预测控制系统中。
AI.keywords: Koopman算子, 再生核希尔伯特空间 (RKHS), 控制系统, 非参数化, 草图技术 (sketching)
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于通过再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）消除了对显式字典或输入参数化的依赖，将控制系统的算子学习与无限维回归理论统一起来。其使用草图技术（sketching）提升了在高维系统中的可扩展性，并在模型预测控制方面展现了良好的应用潜力。

title: Hierarchical Bayesian Crowdsourcing with Item Difficulty
summary: In applied statistics and machine learning, the gold standards used for training are often biased and almost always noisy. Dawid and Skene's justifiably popular crowdsourcing model adjusts for rater sensitivity and specificity, but fails to capture distributional properties of rating data gathered for training, which in turn biases training. In this study, we introduce a general purpose measurement-error model with which we can infer consensus categories by adding item-level effects for difficulty, discriminativeness, and guessability. We further show how to constrain the bimodal posterior of these models to avoid adversarial raters. We validate our model's goodness of fit with posterior predictive checks, the Bayesian analogue of $χ^2$ tests, and assess its predictive accuracy using leave-one-out cross-validation. We illustrate our new model with two well-studied data sets, binary rating data for caries in dental X-rays and implication in natural language.

title: On Regularization via Early Stopping for Least Squares Regression
summary: A fundamental problem in machine learning is understanding the effect of early stopping on the parameters obtained and the generalization capabilities of the model. Even for linear models, the effect is not fully understood for arbitrary learning rates and data. In this paper, we analyze the dynamics of discrete full batch gradient descent for linear regression. With minimal distributional assumptions, we characterize the trajectory of the parameters and the expected excess risk. Using this characterization, we show that when training with any learning rate schedule and finite time horizon, the early stopped solution is equivalent to the minimum norm solution for a generalized ridge regression problem. We also prove that early stopping is beneficial for generic data with arbitrary spectrum and for a wide variety of learning rate schedules. We provide an estimate for the optimal stopping time and empirically demonstrate the accuracy of our estimate.

title: FDLoRA: Personalized Federated Learning of Large Language Model via Dual LoRA Tuning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as important components across various fields, yet their training requires substantial computation resources and abundant labeled data. It poses a challenge to robustly training LLMs for individual users (clients). To tackle this challenge, the intuitive idea is to introduce federated learning (FL), which can collaboratively train models on distributed private data. However, existing methods suffer from the challenges of data heterogeneity, system heterogeneity, and model size, resulting in suboptimal performance and high costs. In this work, we proposed a variant of personalized federated learning (PFL) framework, namely FDLoRA, which allows the client to be a single device or a cluster and adopts low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning. FDLoRA sets dual LoRA modules on each client to capture personalized and global knowledge, respectively, and only the global LoRA module uploads parameters to the central server to aggregate cross-client knowledge. Finally, an adaptive fusion approach is employed to combine the parameters of the dual LoRAs. This enables FDLoRA to make effective use of private data distributed across different clients, thereby improving performance on the client without incurring high communication and computing costs. We conducted extensive experiments in two practice scenarios. The results demonstrate that FDLoRA outperforms six baselines in terms of performance, stability, robustness, computation cost, and communication cost.

title: An Algorithm for the Assignment Game Beyond Additive Valuations
comments: 41 pages, 3 figures. Appeared in the proceedings of EC'24
summary: The assignment game, introduced by Shapley and Shubik (1971), is a classic model for two-sided matching markets between buyers and sellers. In the original assignment game, it is assumed that payments lead to transferable utility and that buyers have unit-demand valuations for items. Two important and mostly independent lines of work have studied more general settings with imperfectly transferable utility and gross substitutes valuations. Multiple efficient algorithms have been proposed for computing a competitive equilibrium, the standard solution concept in assignment games, in these two settings. Our main result is an efficient algorithm for computing competitive equilibria in a setting with both imperfectly transferable utility and gross substitutes valuations. Our algorithm combines augmenting tree techniques from maximum matching and algorithms for matroid intersection. We also show that, in two mild generalizations of our model, computing a competitive equilibrium is NP-hard.
comment: 41 pages, 3 figures. Appeared in the proceedings of EC'24

title: VLMEvalKit: An Open-Source Toolkit for Evaluating Large Multi-Modality Models
summary: We present VLMEvalKit: an open-source toolkit for evaluating large multi-modality models based on PyTorch. The toolkit aims to provide a user-friendly and comprehensive framework for researchers and developers to evaluate existing multi-modality models and publish \textbf{reproducible} evaluation results. In VLMEvalKit, we implement over 450+ large multi-modality model configurations, including both proprietary APIs and open-source models, and support 330+ benchmarks across diverse multi-modal benchmarks. By implementing a single interface, new models can be easily added to the toolkit, while the toolkit automatically handles the remaining workloads, including data preparation, distributed inference, prediction post-processing, and metric calculation. VLMEvalKit has also evolved to a broader evaluation suite spanning video/audio, document understanding, GUI grounding, spatial reasoning, safety, scientific reasoning, and multi-turn dialogue. Based on the evaluation results obtained with the toolkit, we host the OpenVLM Leaderboard, a comprehensive leaderboard to track the progress of multi-modality learning research. The toolkit is released on https://github.com/open-compass/VLMEvalKit and is actively maintained.

title: MambaCapsule: Towards Transparent Cardiac Disease Diagnosis with Electrocardiography Using Mamba Capsule Network
summary: Cardiac arrhythmia, a condition characterized by irregular heartbeats, often serves as an early indication of various heart ailments. With the advent of deep learning, numerous innovative models have been introduced for diagnosing arrhythmias using Electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. However, recent studies solely focus on the performance of models, neglecting the interpretation of their results. This leads to a considerable lack of transparency, posing a significant risk in the actual diagnostic process. To solve this problem, this paper introduces MambaCapsule, a deep neural networks for ECG arrhythmias classification, which increases the explainability of the model while enhancing the accuracy.Our model utilizes Mamba for feature extraction and Capsule networks for prediction, providing not only a confidence score but also signal features. Akin to the processing mechanism of human brain, the model learns signal features and their relationship between them by reconstructing ECG signals in the predicted selection. The model evaluation was conducted on MIT-BIH and PTB dataset, following the AAMI standard. MambaCapsule has achieved a total accuracy of 99.54% and 99.59% on the test sets respectively. These results demonstrate the promising performance of under the standard test protocol.

title: Enabling Personal Dataflow Sovereignty via Bolt-on Data Escrow
summary:
The digital economy is powered by a continuous and massive exchange of personal data. Individuals provide data to platforms in return for services, from social networking and search to health monitoring, entertainment, and access to LLMs. This exchange has created immense value, but it has also established a fundamental asymmetry of power: individuals possess only coarse-grained control over data access rather than fine-grained control over its purpose of use, creating a gap where data can be repurposed for undisclosed uses, e.g., platforms selling the data to data brokers, which results in a critical loss of personal data sovereignty.
  This paper frames this socio-technical challenge as a dataflow management problem. We propose a bolt-on data escrow architecture through delegated computation. In our model, instead of data flowing to platforms, platforms delegate their computation to a trustworthy escrow. This inversion empowers individuals with transparency and control over their dataflows. We present four contributions: (1) a dataflow model that explicitly incorporates computational purpose as a first-class primitive; (2) a minimally invasive programming interface, run(access(), compute()), built on a unified relational interface that virtualizes on-device data sources and a computation offloading component; (3) a concrete implementation of our escrow within the Apple ecosystem, demonstrating its practicality; and (4) both qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrating that our solution is expressive enough to implement a wide range of dataflows from real-world applications and introduces minimal runtime overhead. In summary, our work serves as a stepping stone toward achieving personal dataflow sovereignty.

title: A Simulation Framework for Electromagnetic Signal Injection Attacks on Image Sensors
summary: Image sensors are fundamental to many intelligent systems, allowing visual perception and AI-driven decision-making. However, their integrity can be compromised by electromagnetic signal injection attacks (ESIA), which manipulate captured images without modifying sensor hardware or software. Despite the growing threat, system-level understanding of the attacks, as well as the development of defenses, remains limited, in part because collecting adversarial data is often complex and requires specialized attack setups. To address this challenge, we model ESIA and develop a simulation framework for generating synthetic adversarial images. Our analysis shows that these synthetic images are statistically indistinguishable from those produced by real attacks. The proposed framework enables faster vulnerability evaluation of computer vision (CV) algorithms, without the need for dedicated attack hardware. We also present a pilot study showing that the robustness of the algorithms can be improved by adversarial training, demonstrating a practical and scalable path toward mitigating ESIA threats.

title: Training Verifiably Robust Agents Using Set-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning policies parametrized by deep neural networks have achieved strong performance for continuous control, yet even small input perturbations may lead to unpredictable behavior. This sensitivity limits their use in safety-critical domains, where robustness guarantees are required. Our work addresses this gap between state-of-the-art adversarial training methods and formal verification to train verifiably robust agents. Previous works train networks with individual adversarial perturbations, making them only robust against the specific adversarial attacks used. In contrast, our approach propagates entire perturbed input sets, enclosing all possible adversarial attacks within a single network pass. We leverage this to explicitly penalize the size of the output set (minimizing closed-loop uncertainty) and thereby make the actor robust against all possible attacks. This is realized by the use of set-based policy gradients, where each output within the set has a different gradient, thereby balancing the accuracy and robustness of the network. Doing so, we achieve formal verifiability across different verification frameworks for up to 9 times larger input perturbations compared to standard reinforcement learning and improve certified worst-case performance.

AI.title_translation: 基于集合强化学习训练可验证鲁棒的智能体
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于集合的强化学习方法，通过传播整个受扰动输入集并最小化输出集大小，训练出可验证鲁棒的智能体。
AI.motivation: 深度强化学习策略对微小的输入扰动非常敏感，限制了其在需要鲁棒性保证的安全关键领域的应用；现有的对抗训练方法仅针对特定攻击具有鲁棒性，无法提供形式化验证保证。
AI.method: 提出一种基于集合的强化学习方法。该方法在单次网络前向传播中传播整个受扰动的输入集合（包容所有可能的对抗攻击），并显式地惩罚输出集合的大小以最小化闭环不确定性。通过使用集合值策略梯度（每个集合内的输出具有不同的梯度）来平衡网络的准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在不同的验证框架下，与标准强化学习相比，该方法实现了对高达9倍大输入扰动的形式化可验证性，并提高了经认证的最坏情况性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合集合传播和集合值策略梯度，该方法成功弥合了对抗训练与形式化验证之间的差距，能够有效训练出在连续控制中具有高鲁棒性和形式化验证保证的智能体。
AI.translation: 采用深度神经网络参数化的强化学习策略在连续控制方面取得了强大的性能，但即使是微小的输入扰动也可能导致不可预测的行为。这种敏感性限制了它们在需要鲁棒性保证的安全关键领域的应用。我们的工作弥合了最先进的对抗训练方法与形式化验证之间的差距，以训练出可验证鲁棒的智能体。以前的工作使用单个对抗扰动来训练网络，这使得它们仅对所使用的特定对抗攻击具有鲁棒性。相比之下，我们的方法传播整个受扰动的输入集，在单次网络前向传播中包容所有可能的对抗攻击。我们利用这一点来显式惩罚输出集的大小（最小化闭环不确定性），从而使行动者对所有可能的攻击都具有鲁棒性。这是通过使用基于集合的策略梯度来实现的，其中集合内的每个输出都有不同的梯度，从而平衡了网络的准确性和鲁棒性。通过这种方式，与标准强化学习相比，我们在不同的验证框架下实现了针对高达9倍大输入扰动的形式化可验证性，并提高了经认证的最坏情况性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对深度强化学习策略对输入扰动敏感、难以应用于安全关键领域的问题，提出了一种基于集合的强化学习方法。该方法通过在单次网络传播中传播整个受扰动输入集，并引入集合值策略梯度来显式惩罚输出集大小，从而在保证准确性的同时极大提升了智能体的形式化可验证鲁棒性。实验表明，该方法可承受比传统强化学习高出9倍的输入扰动。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 形式化验证, 鲁棒性, 集合值策略梯度, 对抗训练
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将“集合传播”引入强化学习的训练流程中，避免了传统对抗训练只能针对特定攻击的局限性。通过最小化输出集合大小，直接在优化目标中考虑了最坏情况的鲁棒性。其高达9倍的扰动容忍度提升非常显著，对于自动驾驶、机器人等安全关键领域的强化学习落地具有重要意义。局限性可能在于集合传播和集合梯度的计算开销较大，在超高维状态空间下的可扩展性有待进一步验证。

title: AnyDesign: Versatile Area Fashion Editing via Mask-Free Diffusion
summary: Fashion image editing aims to modify a person's appearance based on a given instruction. Existing methods require auxiliary tools like segmenters and keypoint extractors, lacking a flexible and unified framework. Moreover, these methods are limited in the variety of clothing types they can handle, as most datasets focus on people in clean backgrounds and only include generic garments such as tops, pants, and dresses. These limitations restrict their applicability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we first extend an existing dataset for human generation to include a wider range of apparel and more complex backgrounds. This extended dataset features people wearing diverse items such as tops, pants, dresses, skirts, headwear, scarves, shoes, socks, and bags. Additionally, we propose AnyDesign, a diffusion-based method that enables mask-free editing on versatile areas. Users can simply input a human image along with a corresponding prompt in either text or image format. Our approach incorporates Fashion DiT, equipped with a Fashion-Guidance Attention (FGA) module designed to fuse explicit apparel types and CLIP-encoded apparel features. Both Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our method delivers high-quality fashion editing and outperforms contemporary text-guided fashion editing methods.

AI.title_translation: AnyDesign：基于无掩码扩散的多区域通用时尚编辑
AI.tldr: 本文提出了AnyDesign，一种无需掩码即可进行多区域时尚编辑的扩散模型方法，并扩展了一个包含更丰富服装品类和复杂背景的数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有的时尚图像编辑方法通常依赖分割器、关键点提取器等辅助工具，缺乏灵活统一的框架。此外，现有数据集多局限于干净背景及上衣、裤子、连衣裙等基础款式，限制了其在多样化现实场景中的应用。
AI.method:
1. **数据集扩展**：扩展了现有的人体生成数据集，增加了更丰富的服装品类（如半身裙、头饰、围巾、鞋袜、包包等）以及更复杂的背景。
2. **AnyDesign框架**：一种基于扩散模型的无掩码多区域编辑方法，支持文本或图像格式的提示词。
3. **Fashion DiT与FGA模块**：核心网络采用Fashion DiT，并配备了时尚引导注意力（Fashion-Guidance Attention, FGA）模块，用于融合显式的服装类型与CLIP编码的服装特征。
AI.result: 定性和定量实验结果均表明，AnyDesign能够提供高质量的时尚编辑效果，其性能优于当前的文本引导时尚编辑方法。
AI.conclusion: AnyDesign通过无掩码扩散机制和FGA模块，克服了传统方法依赖辅助工具及服装品类受限的缺陷，实现了高质量、多区域且灵活的时尚图像编辑。
AI.translation: 时尚图像编辑旨在根据给定的指令修改人物的外观。现有方法需要分割器和关键点提取器等辅助工具，缺乏灵活且统一的框架。此外，这些方法在能够处理的服装类型多样性方面受到限制，因为大多数数据集都专注于干净背景下的人物，且仅包含上衣、裤子和连衣裙等通用服装。这些限制制约了它们在现实场景中的适用性。在本文中，我们首先扩展了一个现有的用于人体生成的数据集，以包含更广泛的服饰和更复杂的背景。这个扩展后的数据集包含穿着各种物品（如上衣、裤子、连衣裙、半身裙、头饰、围巾、鞋子、袜子和包包）的人物。此外，我们提出了 AnyDesign，这是一种基于扩散的方法，能够在多个区域进行无掩码编辑。用户只需输入一张人物图像以及相应的文本或图像格式的提示词。我们的方法结合了 Fashion DiT，并配备了时尚引导注意力（FGA）模块，旨在融合显式的服装类型和 CLIP 编码的服装特征。定性和定量实验均表明，我们的方法能够提供高质量的时尚编辑，并优于当下的文本引导时尚编辑方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有时尚图像编辑方法依赖辅助工具且适用服装品类受限的问题，提出了AnyDesign方法。该方法基于无掩码扩散模型，通过结合Fashion DiT和时尚引导注意力（FGA）模块，实现了多区域的灵活时尚编辑。此外，研究者还扩展了现有的时尚数据集，涵盖了更丰富的配饰和复杂背景。实验表明，该方法在编辑质量和灵活性上均优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 时尚图像编辑, 无掩码扩散, 扩散模型, 图像生成
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于摆脱了传统时尚图像编辑对分割掩码（Mask）或关键点提取器等辅助工具的依赖，实现了无掩码（Mask-Free）的灵活编辑。同时，通过扩展数据集引入了头饰、鞋袜、包包等更丰富的配饰品类，极大地拓宽了时尚编辑的应用边界。然而，在无掩码情况下如何精准保持非修改区域（如面部特征、背景细节）的完全一致性，可能仍是一个值得进一步探讨的挑战。

title: DrugAgent: Reliable Multi-Agent Integration of Conflicting Biomedical Evidence for Drug-Target Interaction Assessment
summary:
Workflows in drug-target interaction (DTI) assessment require integrating heterogeneous data from predictive models, curated resources, and observations from experimental literature. This evidence can be incomplete or conflicting. DrugAgent is a large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent system focused on DTI evidence integration that integrates outputs from machine learning, knowledge graph, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents. DrugAgent converts agent outputs into interpretable representations, then summarizes conflict across the evidence.
  We evaluated DrugAgent on kinase screening data of 900 pairs spanning 178 kinases and 42 inhibitors, and an androgen receptor antagonist screening benchmark. On the kinase dataset, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation indicated outputs were faithful to input evidence in 98.8% of cases. Biological plausibility of returned summarization was high (scores 3-4 out of 5) across ground-truth classes: 79% of Weak activity labels cases (81% for Moderate/77% Strong); Strong cases received higher scores than Weak/Moderate. Label stability showed 98% agreement across runs. Results on the antagonist benchmark were consistent with the kinase dataset.
  Retrieved literature provided the greatest benefit when direct drug-target evidence was available, highlighting the importance of evidence availability for RAG-based integration. DrugAgent provides heterogeneous evidence-grounded DTI assessment, complementing standalone DTI prediction. We provide strategies to model agreement, conflict, and uncertainty in biomedical evidence integration. Code: https://github.com/sciluna/DrugAgent.

AI.title_translation: DrugAgent：用于药物-靶点相互作用评估的冲突生物医学证据的可靠多智能体整合
AI.tldr: DrugAgent 是一个基于大模型的多智能体系统，通过整合机器学习、知识图谱和 RAG 智能体，实现了高忠实度、高稳定性的冲突生物医学证据整合与药物-靶点相互作用评估。
AI.motivation: 药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）评估需要整合来自预测模型、人工策画资源和实验文献等多种异构数据，但这些数据往往是不完整或相互冲突的，缺乏可靠的整合方法。
AI.method: 提出了 DrugAgent，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统。该系统集成了机器学习、知识图谱和检索增强生成（RAG）智能体的输出，将这些输出转化为可解释的表示，并对证据之间的冲突进行总结。
AI.result: 在激酶筛选数据集上，LLM裁判评估显示 98.8% 的输出忠实于输入证据，生物学合理性评分较高，多次运行的标签一致性达 98%。在拮抗剂基准上的结果与此一致。此外，检索文献在有直接药物-靶点证据时能提供最大益处。
AI.conclusion: DrugAgent 能够提供基于异构证据的 DTI 评估，是对独立 DTI 预测方法的有力补充。研究还为生物医学证据整合中的一致性、冲突和不确定性建模提供了可行策略。
AI.translation: 药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）评估的工作流需要整合来自预测模型、人工策画资源以及实验文献观察结果的异构数据。这些证据可能是完整性不足或相互冲突的。DrugAgent 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统，专注于 DTI 证据整合，它整合了机器学习、知识图谱和检索增强生成（RAG）智能体的输出。DrugAgent 将智能体的输出转换为可解释的表示，然后总结这些证据之间的冲突。我们在包含 178 个激酶和 42 个抑制剂、跨越 900 个配对的激酶筛选数据，以及一个雄激素受体拮抗剂筛选基准上对 DrugAgent 进行了评估。在激酶数据集上，大模型作为裁判（LLM-as-a-Judge）的评估表明，在 98.8% 的案例中，输出均忠实于输入证据。返回的总结在不同的基准真实类别中表现出较高的生物学合理性（5分中获得3-4分）：弱活性标签案例中为 79%（中等活性为 81%，强活性为 77%）；强活性案例获得的评分高于弱/中等活性。标签稳定性在多次运行中表现出 98% 的一致性。拮抗剂基准上的结果与激酶数据集一致。检索到的文献在有直接药物-靶点证据可用时提供了最大的益处，突出了证据可用性对于基于 RAG 的整合的重要性。DrugAgent 提供了基于异构证据的 DTI 评估，是对独立 DTI 预测的补充。我们提供了在生物医学证据整合中对一致性、冲突和不确定性进行建模的策略。代码：https://github.com/sciluna/DrugAgent。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 DrugAgent，一个基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，旨在整合来自机器学习、知识图谱和 RAG 智能体的异构且可能冲突的药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）证据。实验表明，该系统在激酶和拮抗剂筛选数据集上表现出极高的忠实度、生物学合理性和标签稳定性，为解决生物医学证据冲突和不确定性提供了可靠的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 药物-靶点相互作用, 多智能体系统, 大语言模型, 检索增强生成, 证据整合
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种基于大语言模型的多智能体协同框架（DrugAgent），通过融合机器学习、知识图谱和RAG等多种技术，有效解决了药物-靶点相互作用（DTI）评估中异构数据冲突与不完整的问题。其高保真度（98.8%）和高稳定性（98%）证明了该方法的实用价值。局限性在于，该系统对直接证据的依赖性较强，在缺乏直接文献支持时，RAG带来的增益会受到限制。

title: GQL and SQL/PGQ: Theoretical Models and Expressive Power
summary:
SQL/PGQ and GQL are very recent international standards for querying property graphs: SQL/PGQ specifies how to query relational representations of property graphs in SQL, while GQL is a standalone language for graph databases. The rapid industrial development of these standards left the academic community trailing in its wake. While digests of the languages have appeared, we do not yet have concise foundational models like relational algebra and calculus for relational databases that enable the formal study of languages, including their expressiveness and limitations. At the same time, work on the next versions of the standards has already begun, to address the perceived limitations of their first versions.
  Motivated by this, we initiate a formal study of SQL/PGQ and GQL, concentrating on their concise formal model and expressiveness. For the former, we define simple core languages -- Core GQL and Core PGQ -- that capture the essence of the new standards, are amenable to theoretical analysis, and fully clarify the difference between PGQ's bottom up evaluation versus GQL's linear, or pipelined approach. Equipped with these models, we both confirm the necessity to extend the language to fill in the expressiveness gaps and identify the source of these deficiencies. We complement our theoretical analysis with an experimental study, demonstrating that existing workarounds in full GQL and PGQ are impractical which further underscores the necessity to correct deficiencies in the language design.

AI.title_translation: GQL 与 SQL/PGQ：理论模型与表达能力
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 的形式化模型，分析了它们的表达能力，并指出了现有标准的局限性，为未来的语言设计提供了理论基础和实验证据。
AI.motivation: GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 是用于查询属性图的最新国际标准，但学术界缺乏像关系代数和关系演算那样用于形式化研究的简洁基础模型，这阻碍了对其表达能力和局限性的深入理解。同时，新标准的后续版本已在开发中，需要解决现有版本存在的不足。
AI.method: 论文定义了 GQL 和 PGQ 的核心语言（Core GQL 和 Core PGQ）作为形式化模型，以捕捉新标准的精髓并便于理论分析。通过这些模型，研究人员分析了两种语言在评估方式上的差异，并探讨了它们的表达能力。此外，还进行了实验研究，以验证现有 GQL 和 PGQ 中的变通方法在实践中的不可行性。
AI.result: 研究人员定义了 Core GQL 和 Core PGQ 核心语言，阐明了 PGQ 的自底向上评估与 GQL 的线性或流水线方法之间的区别。研究证实了扩展语言以弥补表达能力差距的必要性，并找出了这些不足的根源。实验研究表明，现有的 GQL 和 PGQ 变通方法不切实际。
AI.conclusion: GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 的形式化模型对于理解和改进这些标准至关重要。研究证实了现有标准在表达能力上存在不足，并强调了在语言设计中解决这些缺陷的必要性。实验结果进一步支持了对语言进行修订的论点。
AI.translation:
SQL/PGQ 和 GQL 是用于查询属性图的最新国际标准：SQL/PGQ 规定了如何在 SQL 中查询关系图表示，而 GQL 是一个独立的图数据库语言。这些标准的快速工业发展使得学术界望尘莫及。虽然这些语言的摘要已经出现，但我们还没有像关系数据库的关系代数和演算那样简洁的基础模型，以支持对语言（包括它们的表达能力和局限性）的正式研究。同时，新标准的后续版本工作已经开始，以解决其第一版本中存在的局限性。

出于这个动机，我们对 SQL/PGQ 和 GQL 进行了形式化研究，重点关注它们的简洁形式化模型和表达能力。对于前者，我们定义了简单的核心语言——Core GQL 和 Core PGQ——它们捕捉了新标准的精髓，便于理论分析，并完全阐明了 PGQ 的自底向上评估与 GQL 的线性或流水线方法之间的区别。借助这些模型，我们既证实了扩展该语言以填补表达能力差距的必要性，也确定了这些缺陷的根源。我们用实验研究来补充我们的理论分析，证明了在完整的 GQL 和 PGQ 中现有的变通方法是不切实际的，这进一步强调了纠正语言设计缺陷的必要性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了 GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 的形式化模型（Core GQL 和 Core PGQ），以解决当前缺乏理论基础支持的问题。研究分析了这两种查询语言的评估方法差异及其表达能力，证实了现有标准存在表达能力上的不足，并指出了其根源。实验研究进一步证明了现有变通方法的不可行性，强调了对 GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 进行修订以弥补其设计缺陷的必要性。
AI.keywords: GQL, SQL/PGQ, 属性图, 查询语言, 形式化模型, 表达能力
AI.comments: 该研究为 GQL 和 SQL/PGQ 这两种新兴的图查询标准提供了重要的理论基础。通过构建简洁的形式化模型，作者不仅清晰地阐述了两种语言的核心差异，还为评估它们的表达能力提供了严谨的框架。研究结果有力地证明了现有标准存在的局限性，并为未来的语言改进指明了方向。实验部分的补充也增加了研究的说服力，强调了理论分析在实际应用中的重要性。然而，该研究主要集中在理论层面，实际语言的实现和性能优化方面的考虑可能需要进一步探索。

title: AMT-APC: Automatic Piano Cover by Fine-Tuning an Automatic Music Transcription Model
summary: There have been several studies on automatically generating piano covers, and recent advancements in deep learning have enabled the creation of more sophisticated covers. However, existing automatic piano cover models still have room for improvement in terms of expressiveness and fidelity to the original. To address these issues, we propose a learning algorithm called AMT-APC, which leverages the capabilities of automatic music transcription models. By utilizing the strengths of well-established automatic music transcription models, we aim to improve the accuracy of piano cover generation. Our experiments demonstrate that the AMT-APC model reproduces original tracks more accurately than any existing models.

AI.title_translation: AMT-APC：通过微调自动音乐转谱模型实现自动钢琴翻奏
AI.tldr: 本文提出 AMT-APC 算法，通过微调自动音乐转谱模型，显著提高了自动钢琴翻奏的还原度与准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的自动钢琴翻奏（APC）模型在表现力以及对原曲的还原度（忠实度）方面仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 AMT-APC 的学习算法，该算法利用并微调了成熟的自动音乐转谱（AMT）模型，以此来提升钢琴翻奏生成的准确性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，AMT-APC 模型在重现原曲的准确性上超越了所有现有的自动钢琴翻奏模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合并微调成熟的自动音乐转谱（AMT）模型，AMT-APC 能够比现有模型更准确地重现原曲，有效提升了自动钢琴翻奏的生成质量。
AI.translation: 关于自动生成钢琴翻奏已经有了若干研究，深度学习的最新进展使得创建更复杂的翻奏成为可能。然而，现有的自动钢琴翻奏模型在表现力和对原曲的还原度方面仍有提升空间。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为 AMT-APC 的学习算法，该算法利用了自动音乐转谱模型的能力。通过利用成熟的自动音乐转谱模型的优势，我们的目标是提高钢琴翻奏生成的准确性。我们的实验表明，AMT-APC 模型比任何现有模型都能更准确地重现原曲。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有自动钢琴翻奏模型在表现力和还原度上的不足，提出了一种名为 AMT-APC 的新算法。该算法通过微调成熟的自动音乐转谱（AMT）模型，充分利用其音频解析能力来提升翻奏生成的准确性。实验证明，AMT-APC 能够比现有模型更精确地重现原曲。
AI.keywords: 自动钢琴翻奏, 自动音乐转谱, 微调, 深度学习
AI.comments:
创新性：该研究巧妙地将成熟的自动音乐转谱（AMT）模型引入到自动钢琴翻奏（APC）任务中，通过微调来迁移其强大的音频特征提取和转谱能力，这一思路具有很强的实用性。
重要性：提升了钢琴翻奏在表现力和原曲还原度上的表现，对自动音乐生成、音乐改编及娱乐互动等领域具有推动作用。
局限性：摘要中未详细说明具体的微调机制、所使用的网络架构以及实验所用的数据集，且未提及是否进行了主观听感评估。

title: TiROD: Tiny Robotics Dataset and Benchmark for Continual Object Detection
comments: Accepted at Journal of Intelligent Robotics & Systems
summary: Detecting objects with visual sensors is crucial for numerous mobile robotics applications, from autonomous navigation to inspection. However, robots often need to operate under significant domains shifts from those they were trained in, requiring them to adjust to these changes. Tiny mobile robots, subject to size, power, and computational constraints, face even greater challenges when running and adapting detection models on low-resolution and noisy images. Such adaptability, though, is crucial for real-world deployment, where robots must operate effectively in dynamic and unpredictable settings. In this work, we introduce a new vision benchmark to evaluate lightweight continual learning strategies tailored to the unique characteristics of tiny robotic platforms. Our contributions include: (i) Tiny Robotics Object Detection~(TiROD), a challenging video dataset collected using the onboard camera of a small mobile robot, designed to test object detectors across various domains and classes; (ii) a comprehensive benchmark of several continual learning strategies on different scenarios using NanoDet, a lightweight, real-time object detector for resource-constrained devices.. Our results highlight some key challenges in developing robust and efficient continual learning strategies for object detectors in tiny robotics.es; (ii) a benchmark of different continual learning strategies on this dataset using NanoDet, a lightweight object detector. Our results highlight key challenges in developing robust and efficient continual learning strategies for object detectors in tiny robotics.

AI.title_translation: TiROD：用于持续目标检测的微型机器人数据集与基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文发布了 TiROD 数据集和基准测试，旨在解决微型机器人在资源受限情况下，如何通过持续学习适应动态环境目标检测的挑战。
AI.motivation: 微型机器人受限于尺寸、功耗和算力，在处理低分辨率和噪声图像时，难以应对现实世界中常见的域偏移问题，亟需专门针对这些限制的持续学习策略。
AI.method: 构建了 TiROD 数据集，并基于 NanoDet 轻量级目标检测器，在多种持续学习场景下对不同的策略进行了系统性基准测试与评估。
AI.result: 通过基准测试揭示了在微型机器人平台开发稳健、高效的目标检测持续学习策略时所面临的关键挑战，为后续研究提供了基础。
AI.conclusion: TiROD 为微型机器人领域的持续目标检测提供了一个具有挑战性的数据集和评估框架，揭示了在资源受限环境下实现鲁棒持续学习的严峻挑战。
AI.translation: 视觉传感器目标检测对于自动导航和巡检等移动机器人应用至关重要。然而，机器人经常需要在与训练环境存在显著域偏移的场景下工作，需要进行自适应调整。受限于尺寸、功耗和算力，微型移动机器人在低分辨率和噪声图像上运行及调整检测模型时面临更大挑战。这种适应性对于机器人必须在动态和不可预测环境中有效运行的实际部署至关重要。本文引入了一个新的视觉基准，用于评估针对微型机器人平台独特特性量身定制的轻量级持续学习策略。我们的贡献包括：(i) TiROD，一个具有挑战性的视频数据集，通过小型移动机器人的机载摄像头采集，旨在测试跨不同域和类别的目标检测器；(ii) 基于 NanoDet（一种用于资源受限设备的轻量级实时目标检测器）在不同场景下对多种持续学习策略的全面基准测试。我们的结果强调了在微型机器人领域开发稳健且高效的目标检测持续学习策略所面临的关键挑战。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 TiROD 数据集，这是一个专门针对微型机器人平台设计的视频数据集，旨在测试目标检测模型在多域、多类别下的适应性。同时，作者基于轻量级检测器 NanoDet 建立了一个基准测试框架，用于评估不同持续学习策略在资源受限环境下的表现。
AI.keywords: 微型机器人, 持续学习, 目标检测, 资源受限, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文填补了微型机器人领域持续学习基准测试的空白，特别关注资源受限设备上的目标检测适应性。其创新之处在于提供了真实场景下的微型机器人视频数据集，并评估了轻量级模型在动态环境下的性能表现。局限性在于其主要侧重于单一架构（NanoDet）的评估，未来可拓展至更多轻量级模型。

title: Mitigating Covariate Shift in Imitation Learning for Autonomous Vehicles Using Latent Space Generative World Models
comments: 8 pages, 6 figures, original September 2024, accepted at ICRA 2025 Workshop "Robots in the Wild", for associated video file, see https://youtu.be/7m3bXzlVQvU
summary: We propose the use of latent space generative world models to address the covariate shift problem in autonomous driving. A world model is a neural network capable of predicting an agent's next state given past states and actions. By leveraging a world model during training, the driving policy effectively mitigates covariate shift without requiring an excessive amount of training data. During end-to-end training, our policy learns how to recover from errors by aligning with states observed in human demonstrations, so that at runtime it can recover from perturbations outside the training distribution. Additionally, we introduce a novel transformer-based perception encoder that employs multi-view cross-attention and a learned scene query. We present qualitative and quantitative results, demonstrating significant improvements upon prior state of the art in closed-loop testing in the CARLA simulator, as well as showing the ability to handle perturbations in both CARLA and NVIDIA's DRIVE Sim.

AI.title_translation: 利用潜空间生成式世界模型缓解自动驾驶模仿学习中的协变量偏移
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入潜空间生成式世界模型和新型Transformer感知编码器，有效缓解了自动驾驶模仿学习中的协变量偏移问题，显著提升了系统在模拟环境中的抗扰动与恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决自动驾驶模仿学习中常见的协变量偏移（covariate shift）问题，避免系统在面对训练分布之外的微扰时无法恢复，同时减少对海量训练数据的依赖。
AI.method: 提出使用潜空间生成式世界模型（用于预测给定过去状态和动作的下一个状态），在端到端训练中让驾驶策略通过与人类演示中观察到的状态对齐来学习如何从错误中恢复。此外，引入了一种新型的、基于Transformer的感知编码器，该编码器采用了多视角交叉注意力（multi-view cross-attention）和学习到的场景查询（learned scene query）。
AI.result: 在CARLA模拟器的闭环测试中，该方法相比于以往的前沿技术（SOTA）取得了显著的定性和定量提升，并且在CARLA和NVIDIA的DRIVE Sim中均展示出了出色的抗扰动和恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用潜空间生成式世界模型，驾驶策略可以在不需要海量训练数据的情况下有效缓解协变量偏移，使自动驾驶系统在运行时能够成功从训练分布之外的扰动中恢复。
AI.translation: 我们提出使用潜空间生成式世界模型来解决自动驾驶中的协变量偏移问题。世界模型是一种能够根据过去的状态和动作预测智能体下一个状态的神经网络。通过在训练过程中利用世界模型，驾驶策略在不需要过多训练数据的情况下，能够有效缓解协变量偏移。在端到端训练期间，我们的策略通过与人类演示中观察到的状态进行对齐，学习如何从错误中恢复，从而使其在运行时能够从训练分布之外的扰动中恢复。此外，我们引入了一种新型的基于Transformer的感知编码器，该编码器采用多视角交叉注意力机制和学习到的场景查询。我们展示了定性和定量的结果，证明了在CARLA模拟器的闭环测试中，该方法相比于以往的最先进技术有了显著的提升，并且展示了在CARLA和英伟达的DRIVE Sim中处理扰动的能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用潜空间生成式世界模型来解决自动驾驶模仿学习中协变量偏移问题的方法。该方法通过世界模型预测状态，在端到端训练中引导策略与人类演示状态对齐，从而学会在运行时从分布外扰动中恢复。同时，论文还引入了一种基于Transformer的多视角感知编码器。在CARLA和DRIVE Sim中的测试表明，该方法显著提升了自动驾驶策略的闭环控制表现和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 模仿学习, 协变量偏移, 世界模型, Transformer感知编码器
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将潜空间生成式世界模型引入到自动驾驶的模仿学习中，通过在训练中预测未来状态并与人类演示对齐，有效且低成本地解决了协变量偏移这一经典难题。引入基于多视角交叉注意力的Transformer感知编码器进一步提升了系统的感知能力。然而，其局限性在于实验主要在虚拟模拟器（CARLA和NVIDIA DRIVE Sim）中进行，实际物理世界中的泛化与安全性能仍有待验证。

title: OnePath: Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Decision Tree Inference in the Cloud
summary: The vast storage capacity and computational power of cloud servers have led to the widespread outsourcing of machine learning inference services. While offering significant operational benefits, this practice also introduces privacy risks, such as the exposure of proprietary models and sensitive user data. In this paper, we present OnePath, a framework for secure and efficient decision tree inference in cloud environments. Unlike existing methods that traverse all internal nodes of a decision tree, our traversal protocol processes only the nodes on the prediction path, significantly improving inference efficiency while preserving privacy. To further optimize privacy and performance, OnePath is the first to employ functional encryption for evaluating decision tree nodes. Notably, our protocol enables both model providers and users to remain offline during the inference phase, offering a crucial advantage for practical deployment. We provide formal security analysis to demonstrate that OnePath provides comprehensive privacy protections during the model inference process. Extensive experimental results show that our approach processes query data in microseconds, highlighting its efficiency. OnePath offers a practical solution that strikes a balance between security and performance, making it a promising option for a wide range of cloud-based decision tree inference applications.

AI.title_translation: 云端高效且注重隐私的决策树推理：OnePath
AI.tldr: OnePath 提出了一种在云端进行决策树推理的框架，通过只遍历预测路径而非所有节点，并利用函数式加密技术，实现了高效且保护隐私的推理，同时允许模型提供者和用户在推理过程中离线。
AI.motivation: 云端机器学习推理虽然带来了便利，但也存在模型和用户数据泄露的隐私风险。
AI.method: OnePath 提出了一种新的遍历协议，仅处理预测路径上的节点，并首次采用函数式加密技术来评估决策树节点，以提高隐私和效率。该协议允许模型提供者和用户在推理过程中离线。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，OnePath 的查询处理速度达到微秒级别，证明了其高效性。
AI.conclusion: OnePath 提供了一个在安全和性能之间取得平衡的实用解决方案，适用于广泛的云端决策树推理应用。
AI.translation: 云端机器学习推理服务的广泛外包已成为一种趋势，这得益于云服务器巨大的存储容量和计算能力。尽管这种做法带来了显著的运营优势，但同时也带来了隐私风险，例如专有模型和敏感用户数据的暴露。在本文中，我们提出了 OnePath，一个用于云环境中安全高效的决策树推理框架。与遍历决策树所有内部节点的现有方法不同，我们的遍历协议仅处理预测路径上的节点，从而在保护隐私的同时显著提高了推理效率。为了进一步优化隐私和性能，OnePath 首次采用函数式加密技术来评估决策树节点。值得注意的是，我们的协议允许模型提供者和用户在推理阶段保持离线，这对于实际部署具有关键优势。我们提供了正式的安全分析，证明 OnePath 在模型推理过程中提供了全面的隐私保护。广泛的实验结果表明，我们的方法处理查询数据的速度达到微秒级别，凸显了其高效性。OnePath 提供了一个实用的解决方案，在安全和性能之间取得了平衡，使其成为广泛的云端决策树推理应用的有希望的选择。
AI.summary: OnePath 是一个创新的云端决策树推理框架，通过优化节点遍历（仅处理预测路径）和采用函数式加密技术，显著提高了效率并保护了隐私。该框架允许双方在推理过程中离线，并经实验验证具有微秒级的查询处理速度，为云端应用提供了一个安全高效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 决策树推理, 云计算, 隐私保护, 函数式加密, 高效性
AI.comments: 该研究在决策树推理的效率和隐私保护方面取得了显著进展，特别是在云环境中。通过仅遍历预测路径和采用函数式加密，OnePath 有效地解决了现有方法的局限性。允许模型提供者和用户离线操作是该框架的一个亮点，大大增强了其实用性。然而，实际部署中函数式加密的开销和可扩展性仍需进一步关注。

title: VLMGuard: Bootstrapping Malicious Prompt Detectors from Unlabeled Vision-Language Prompts in the Wild
comments: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (07/2026)
summary: Vision-language Models (VLMs) are essential for contextual understanding of both visual and textual information. However, their vulnerability to adversarially manipulated inputs presents significant risks, leading to compromised outputs and raising concerns about the reliability in VLM-integrated applications. Detecting these malicious prompts is thus crucial for maintaining trust in VLM generations. A major challenge in developing a safeguarding prompt classifier is the lack of a large amount of labeled benign and malicious data. To address the issue, we introduce VLMGuard, a novel learning framework that leverages the unlabeled user prompts in the wild for malicious prompt detection. These unlabeled prompts, which naturally arise when VLMs are deployed in the open world, consist of both benign and malicious information. To harness the unlabeled data, we present an automated maliciousness estimation score for distinguishing between benign and malicious samples within this unlabeled mixture, thereby enabling the training of a binary prompt classifier on top. Notably, our framework does not require extra human annotations and is robust to realistic prompt variations, offering strong flexibility and practicality for real-world applications. Extensive experiments show that VLMGuard achieves superior detection results, improving AUROC by 5.39% on average over the state-of-the-art method. Disclaimer: This paper may contain offensive examples; reader discretion is advised. Code is available at: https://github.com/radiolab-ntu/vlmguard.

AI.title_translation: VLMGuard：从野外未标记的视觉语言提示中自举恶意提示检测器
AI.tldr: VLMGuard利用野外未标记的视觉语言提示数据，通过自动恶意性估计分数训练恶意提示检测器，无需人工标注，并显著提升检测性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）容易受到对抗性操纵输入的攻击，导致输出受损，并引发对其可靠性的担忧。检测这些恶意提示至关重要，但主要挑战是缺乏大量的标记良性和恶意数据。
AI.method: 本文引入了VLMGuard框架，该框架利用野外未标记的用户提示进行恶意提示检测。它提出一个自动恶意性估计分数来区分未标记混合数据中的良性和恶意样本，从而在此基础上训练一个二元提示分类器。该框架不需要额外的人工标注。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，VLMGuard取得了卓越的检测结果，平均AUROC比现有最先进方法提高了5.39%。
AI.conclusion: VLMGuard是一个无需额外人工标注且对真实提示变化具有鲁棒性的框架，为实际应用提供了强大的灵活性和实用性，并能显著提高恶意提示检测的性能。

AI.summary: 本文介绍了VLMGuard，一个针对视觉语言模型（VLMs）中恶意提示检测的新型框架。鉴于VLM对对抗性输入的脆弱性以及缺乏标记数据的问题，VLMGuard利用野外未标记的VLM提示。它通过一个自动恶意性估计分数来区分未标记数据中的良性和恶意样本，进而训练一个二元提示分类器。该方法无需人工标注，对提示变化具有鲁棒性，并在实验中将AUROC平均提高了5.39%，显著优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 恶意提示检测, 未标记数据, 自监督学习, VLMGuard
AI.comments: VLMGuard的创新之处在于其无需人工标注即可从野外未标记数据中自举恶意提示检测器的能力，这极大地解决了VLM安全领域数据稀缺的痛点。其自动化恶意性估计机制和对现实提示变化的鲁棒性，使其在实际部署中具有很高的实用价值和灵活性。

title: TrendFact: A Benchmark Towards Hotspot Perception in Automatic Fact-Checking
summary: With the surge of online misinformation, Large Language Models (LLMs) and Reasoning Large Language Models (RLMs) serving as Automatic Fact-Checking (AFC) systems have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reliable, explainable verification. However, our empirical study reveals that this paradigm faces a critical risk asymmetry challenge when deployed in the real world under resource-constrained environments. While Hotspot Perception Ability (HPA), the capacity to dynamically allocate reasoning resources based on social impact, is essential to mitigate this risk, existing benchmarks lack the social metadata and evaluation framework to meet this urgent evaluation needs, thereby hindering the advancement of these AFC systems. To bridge this gap, we introduce TrendFact, the first benchmark capable of evaluating HPA and three fact-checking tasks. It consists of 7,643 curated samples sourced from trending platforms and professional datasets, with an evidence library containing 366,634 entries. To enable HPA assessment, we propose two novel metrics: the Explanation Consistency Score (ECS) to evaluate the reliability of verification reasoning, and the Hotspot Claim Perception Index (HCPI) to quantify the overall HPA of AFC systems. Extensive experiments demonstrate that existing AFC systems exhibit limited performance on TrendFact. Furthermore, our proposed FactISR framework effectively enhances HPA and computational efficiency for RLMs-served AFC systems.

AI.title_translation: TrendFact：一个面向自动事实核查中热点感知能力的基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了TrendFact基准，用于评估自动事实核查（AFC）系统中热点感知能力（HPA），并引入了新的评估指标和FactISR框架，以解决现有AFC系统在资源受限环境下处理在线错误信息时的风险不对称挑战。
AI.motivation: 随着在线错误信息的激增，基于大型语言模型（LLMs）和推理大型语言模型（RLMs）的自动事实核查（AFC）系统面临在资源受限环境下部署时存在的关键风险不对称挑战。现有基准缺乏评估热点感知能力（HPA）所需的社会元数据和评估框架，从而阻碍了AFC系统的发展。
AI.method: 本文引入了TrendFact，这是第一个能够评估HPA和三个事实核查任务的基准，包含7,643个来自热门平台和专业数据集的精选样本，以及一个包含366,634个条目的证据库。为评估HPA，提出了两个新颖的指标：解释一致性得分（ECS）用于评估验证推理的可靠性，热点声明感知指数（HCPI）用于量化AFC系统的整体HPA。此外，还提出了FactISR框架以增强RLMs-served AFC系统的HPA和计算效率。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，现有AFC系统在TrendFact上的性能有限。此外，本文提出的FactISR框架有效地增强了RLMs-served AFC系统的HPA和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: TrendFact基准及其提出的度量标准和FactISR框架解决了自动事实核查系统中热点感知能力评估的空白，并为未来AFC系统在真实世界部署中的可靠性和效率提升提供了方向。
AI.translation: 随着在线错误信息的激增，大型语言模型（LLMs）和推理大型语言模型（RLMs）作为自动事实核查（AFC）系统，已成为可靠、可解释验证的重要范式。然而，我们的实证研究表明，这种范式在资源受限的真实世界环境中部署时面临一个关键的风险不对称挑战。尽管热点感知能力（HPA），即根据社会影响力动态分配推理资源的能力，对于缓解这种风险至关重要，但现有基准缺乏社会元数据和评估框架来满足这一紧急评估需求，从而阻碍了这些AFC系统的发展。为了弥合这一差距，我们引入了TrendFact，这是第一个能够评估HPA和三个事实核查任务的基准。它包含7,643个来自热门平台和专业数据集的精选样本，以及一个包含366,634个条目的证据库。为了实现HPA评估，我们提出了两个新颖的指标：解释一致性得分（ECS）用于评估验证推理的可靠性，以及热点声明感知指数（HCPI）用于量化AFC系统的整体HPA。广泛的实验表明，现有AFC系统在TrendFact上的性能有限。此外，我们提出的FactISR框架有效地增强了由RLMs服务的AFC系统的HPA和计算效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TrendFact，这是一个旨在评估自动事实核查（AFC）系统中热点感知能力（HPA）的基准。鉴于现有AFC系统在处理在线错误信息时面临的资源受限和风险不对称挑战，TrendFact提供了7,643个样本和366,634个证据条目，并引入了ECS和HCPI两个新颖指标来量化HPA。实验表明现有AFC系统性能有限，而本文提出的FactISR框架能有效提升HPA和计算效率。
AI.keywords: 自动事实核查, 热点感知能力, 基准, 大型语言模型, 错误信息
AI.comments: 本文通过引入TrendFact基准及其配套的评估指标（ECS和HCPI），创新性地解决了自动事实核查领域中热点感知能力评估的空白。这对于提升AFC系统在资源受限真实世界环境中的实用性和可靠性至关重要，特别是在处理具有不同社会影响力的信息时。提出的FactISR框架也为优化现有AFC系统提供了新的思路。

title: Classifying bioacoustic data without individual call annotations using temporal convolutional networks and feature extractors
summary: Bioacoustic data from Passive Acoustic Monitoring (PAM) generates large datasets where obtaining detailed auditing and labelling is often impractical, resulting in weak annotations (e.g., presence/absence of species over several minutes of recording). In order to effectively capture the complex temporal patterns and key features of long audio segments, we propose a framework comprising dataset standardisation, feature extraction, and classification via Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN). This approach eliminates the necessity for setting heuristic decision rules or creating time-consuming strong labels. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, we use sperm whale (\textit{Physeter macrocephalus}) click trains in 4-minute recordings as a case study, from a dataset comprising diverse sources and deployment conditions to maximise generalisability. Our TCN classifiers achieve recall rates exceeding 0.83 at a 0.13 false positive rate, comparable to agreement rates between expert annotators. We compare two methods of feature extraction, Variational AutoEncoders (VAEs) and traditional handpicking of features, and found them to yield similar performance results, with the VAE-based classifiers seeing a more stable performance across datasets and recording conditions. These results offer a way forward in leveraging numerous existing annotated bioacoustic datasets to train automatic classification models, effectively overcoming previous limitations associated with weak labels.

AI.title_translation: 在没有个体呼叫标注的情况下，利用时间卷积网络和特征提取器对生物声学数据进行分类
AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需精细标注的生物声学分类框架，通过 TCN 和 VAE 实现了高效且稳健的物种识别。
AI.motivation: 被动声学监测（PAM）产生的数据量巨大，获取精细的音频标注既耗时又不切实际，导致数据多为弱标注，亟需一种无需强标注即可进行有效分类的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种包含数据集标准化、特征提取（比较了VAE和手工特征）以及基于时间卷积网络（TCN）分类的框架，无需逐个音频片段的精细标注。
AI.result: 在抹香鲸咔哒声序列的分类任务中，TCN 分类器在 0.13 的误报率下实现了超过 0.83 的召回率，且基于 VAE 的特征提取在不同数据集和记录条件下表现出比手工特征更强的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在弱监督标签下，使用 TCN 和 VAE 进行生物声学分类是可行且高效的，能够达到与人类专家相当的准确度，为处理大规模 PAM 数据提供了新的解决方案。
AI.translation: 来自被动声学监测（PAM）的生物声学数据产生了庞大的数据集，对其进行详细的审计和标注往往不切实际，导致了弱标注（例如：几分钟录音内物种的存在/不存在）。为了有效捕捉长音频片段中的复杂时间模式和关键特征，我们提出了一个包含数据集标准化、特征提取和通过时间卷积网络（TCN）进行分类的框架。该方法消除了设置启发式决策规则或创建耗时的强标签的必要性。为了证明我们方法的有效性，我们以 4 分钟录音中的抹香鲸（Physeter macrocephalus）咔哒声序列作为案例研究，该数据集来自多种来源和部署条件，以最大化泛化能力。我们的 TCN 分类器在 0.13 的误报率下实现了超过 0.83 的召回率，与专家标注者之间的一致率相当。我们比较了两种特征提取方法：变分自编码器（VAEs）和传统的手工特征提取，发现它们产生了相似的性能结果，其中基于 VAE 的分类器在不同数据集和记录条件下表现出更稳定的性能。这些结果为利用大量现有的已标注生物声学数据集来训练自动分类模型提供了一条途径，有效地克服了之前与弱标签相关的限制。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用时间卷积网络（TCN）对生物声学数据进行分类的框架，通过结合变分自编码器（VAE）提取特征，有效解决了大规模被动声学监测数据中缺乏精细标注的问题。实验表明，该方法在抹香鲸数据上达到了专家级识别水平，并表现出良好的稳健性。
AI.keywords: 生物声学, 时间卷积网络, 变分自编码器, 弱监督学习, 被动声学监测
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用时间卷积网络（TCN）结合自动特征提取（VAE），成功在缺乏精细标注的弱监督条件下实现了生物声学数据的有效分类。这对于处理大规模被动声学监测（PAM）数据具有重要意义，因为它规避了高昂的人工标注成本。局限性在于该案例研究主要针对抹香鲸的咔哒声序列，其通用性在其他物种上的表现仍需进一步验证。

title: "So Am I Dr. Frankenstein? Or Were You a Monster the Whole Time?": Mitigating Software Project Failure With Loss-Aversion-Aware Development Methodologies
comments: Peer-reviewed citation: Ali, J. (2025). "So am I Dr. Frankenstein? Or were you a monster the whole time?": Mitigating software project failure with loss-aversion-aware development methodologies. Computer Science & Information Technology (CS & IT), 15(6), 1--9. Link: https://aircconline.com/csit/papers/vol15/csit150601.pdf
summary: Case studies have shown that software disasters snowball from technical issues to catastrophes through humans covering up problems rather than addressing them and empirical research has found the psychological safety of software engineers to discuss and address problems to be foundational to improving project success. However, the failure to do so can be attributed to psychological factors like loss aversion. We conduct a large-scale study of the experiences of 600 software engineers in the UK and USA on project success experiences. Empirical evaluation finds that approaches like ensuring clear requirements before the start of development, when loss aversion is at its lowest, correlated to 97% higher project success. The freedom of software engineers to discuss and address problems correlates with 87% higher success rates. The findings support the development of software development methodologies with a greater focus on human factors in preventing failure.
